# REST reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:reference` (scripts/docs-reference.ts); edit the code or scripts/reference/, not this file. -->

Every HTTP route the Tabularius server answers. Each section names the source file in packages/server/src that handles it; the reference test fails when a route the code matches is missing here. Paths are relative to the server's address (`http://127.0.0.1:8080` unless `--port`, `--host` or HTTPS say otherwise). Values in the examples (file, layout and account names, ids, tokens) are made up; their shape is what the server sends.

For the MCP tools served at `/mcp`, see [mcp.md](mcp.md).

<a id="data-api-sessions"></a>

## Data API: sessions and sign-in

The FileMaker Data API–compatible REST API lives under /fmi/data/{version}/, where version is vLatest, v1 or v2. Sign in with HTTP Basic at POST …/databases/{database}/sessions; the token comes back in the body and in the X-FM-Data-Access-Token header, and later calls send it as Authorization: Bearer {token}. A session idles out after 15 minutes (Data API sessions always do; a web-client session whose privilege set turns idle disconnect off stays signed in for up to 24 hours idle instead, and a disabled account's session ends at once). Every reply is {"response": …, "messages": [{"code", "message"}]}, with code "0" on success; on an error the response is {} and the code is a FileMaker error code (952 for a bad token, 212 for a failed sign-in, 3 "Command is unavailable" with 404 for an unknown path).

Source: `packages/server/src/dataapi.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions`](#data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions) | Signs in to a hosted file with an account name and password and returns a session token. |
| PATCH | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions`](#data-api-sessions-patch-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions) | Changes the signed-in account's own password, which clears an owed password change for the session. |
| DELETE | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/{sessionToken}`](#data-api-sessions-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-sessiontoken) | Signs out: ends the session the path names, releasing its record locks. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/validateSession`](#data-api-sessions-get-fmi-data-version-validatesession) | Checks whether a session token is still live, without resetting its idle timer. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/passkey`](#data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-passkey) | Signs in with a passkey: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/passkey-2fa`](#data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-passkey-2fa) | Signs in with a password and a passkey as the second factor: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/recovery`](#data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-recovery) | Signs in with one of the account's one-time recovery codes and returns a session token. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/recovery-codes`](#data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-recovery-codes) | Makes a fresh set of ten recovery codes for the signed-in account, replacing any it had, and returns them once. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey/register/options`](#data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey-register-options) | Starts registering a passkey for the signed-in account: returns a challenge and the credential ids it already has. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey/register`](#data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey-register) | Finishes registering a passkey for the signed-in account and returns its credential id. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey`](#data-api-sessions-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey) | Lists the signed-in account's passkeys, newest first. |
| DELETE | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey/{credentialId}`](#data-api-sessions-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey-credentialid) | Removes one of the signed-in account's own passkeys. |

<a id="data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions`

Signs in to a hosted file with an account name and password and returns a session token.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic with a local account's name and password, or, when an LDAP/Active Directory server is configured, a directory name and password that matches one of the file's external accounts. The privilege set must have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect when X-Tabularius-Client: web is sent), else 9 (401). A local-only account may sign in only from the server itself (212, 401).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `fmDataSource` | body | array | no | External file credentials: {database, username, password}. At most 20 entries; a longer list is 960 (400) before any password check. Repeated database names are ignored case-insensitively after the first entry. |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Basic base64(account:password) |
| `X-Tabularius-OTP` | header | string | no | The one-time code, for an account with an authenticator app set up |
| `X-Tabularius-Client` | header | string | no | "web" for a web-client session (needs fmapp or fmwebdirect instead of fmrest) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/sessions
Authorization: Basic <base64(account:password)>
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "token": "<session-token>"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

The token is also sent in the X-FM-Data-Access-Token response header. A wrong name or password is 212 (401), and after too many failures 212 says when to try again. An account with an authenticator app set up and no X-Tabularius-OTP gets 1211 (401), as does a wrong code. When a second factor is required (the file requires one for full-access accounts, or the account is set to require one) and a passkey is the account's only second factor, the answer is 9000 (401): sign in at …/sessions/passkey-2fa instead. A full-access account without any second factor (authenticator app or passkey), when the file requires one, or an account set to require one, is refused with 9 (403) (a passkey counts as a second factor). When the account owes a password change the response adds "passwordChangeRequired": true, and the session may only change its password (PATCH …/sessions) or sign out. An unknown file is 802 (404).

<a id="data-api-sessions-patch-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions"></a>

### `PATCH /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions`

Changes the signed-in account's own password, which clears an owed password change for the session.

**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token); allowed even when the session owes a password change. Changes only the session's own account.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `oldPassword` | body | string | yes | The current password |
| `newPassword` | body | string | yes | The new password; must differ from the current one and meet the file's password policy |

**Example:**

```http
PATCH /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/sessions
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "oldPassword": "<current-password>",
  "newPassword": "<new-password>"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Every other session of the account is signed out; the one making the change stays. A missing newPassword is 960 (400); a wrong current password 212 (401); a new password equal to the old one, or one the policy rejects, 960 (400).

<a id="data-api-sessions-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-sessiontoken"></a>

### `DELETE /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/{sessionToken}`

Signs out: ends the session the path names, releasing its record locks.

**Permissions:** None beyond knowing the token: the token in the path is the credential, and no Authorization header is read.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `sessionToken` | path | string | yes | The session token to end |

**Example:**

```http
DELETE /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/sessions/<session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Answers {} whether or not the token was live.

<a id="data-api-sessions-get-fmi-data-version-validatesession"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/validateSession`

Checks whether a session token is still live, without resetting its idle timer.

**Permissions:** Authorization: Bearer {token} (only the Authorization header is read here); a missing, unknown or idle token is 952 (401).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token} |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/validateSession
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "isSessionInUse": false
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Checking a token does not keep it alive, as on FileMaker Server: only calls that use the token do.

<a id="data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-passkey"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/passkey`

Signs in with a passkey: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token.

**Permissions:** None to start; the passkey assertion is the credential. The account's privilege set must still have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect with X-Tabularius-Client: web), and a local-only account may sign in only from the server itself.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `account` | body | string | no | First step only: the account, so its credential ids come back in allowCredentials |
| `response` | body | object | no | Second step: the assertion, {credentialId, clientDataJSON, authenticatorData, signature, challenge} (base64url strings; challenge is the one issued) |
| `X-Tabularius-Client` | header | string | no | "web" for a web-client session |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/sessions/passkey
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account": "Admin"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "challenge": "q8yC2m0w7Zr4Jx1sV9eT3nLb6uKdP5aHfGiOjYcRtE0",
    "rpId": "data.example.com",
    "allowCredentials": []
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

The second step answers {"token": …} (plus "passwordChangeRequired": true when one is owed) and sets X-FM-Data-Access-Token. The rpId and origin come from --public-url when it is set, else from the request's Host (or X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-Proto, believed only from a reverse proxy on the server's own computer, which must overwrite them; behind any other proxy set --public-url). A challenge is good once, for 5 minutes; an expired, replayed, unknown or failing assertion, or an inactive account, is 212 (401).

<a id="data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-passkey-2fa"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/passkey-2fa`

Signs in with a password and a passkey as the second factor: without an assertion it issues a challenge; with one it verifies it and returns a session token.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic with the account's name and password (the first factor is checked on both steps), and the account must have a passkey. The privilege set must have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect with X-Tabularius-Client: web).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Basic base64(account:password) |
| `response` | body | object | no | Second step: the assertion, {credentialId, clientDataJSON, authenticatorData, signature, challenge} (base64url strings; challenge is the one issued). Leave the body empty for the first step. |
| `X-Tabularius-Client` | header | string | no | "web" for a web-client session |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/sessions/passkey-2fa
Authorization: Basic <base64(account:password)>
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "challenge": "q8yC2m0w7Zr4Jx1sV9eT3nLb6uKdP5aHfGiOjYcRtE0",
    "rpId": "data.example.com",
    "allowCredentials": [
      "AV3k9x2LmQ7rT1yZ"
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Unlike …/sessions/passkey, this does not replace the password. allowCredentials lists only this account's own passkeys. The second step answers {"token": …} (plus "passwordChangeRequired": true when one is owed) and sets X-FM-Data-Access-Token. A wrong name or password is 212 (401); an account with no passkey is 1211 (401); a failing assertion is answered with its error in 401 and is recorded as a failed two-factor sign-in.

<a id="data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-sessions-recovery"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/sessions/recovery`

Signs in with one of the account's one-time recovery codes and returns a session token.

**Permissions:** None beyond the account name and an unused recovery code; each code works once. The privilege set must have fmrest (fmapp or fmwebdirect with X-Tabularius-Client: web).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `account` | body | string | yes | The account name |
| `code` | body | string | yes | A recovery code, such as a1b2-c3d4-e5f6 |
| `X-Tabularius-Client` | header | string | no | "web" for a web-client session |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/sessions/recovery
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "account": "Admin",
  "code": "a1b2-c3d4-e5f6"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "token": "7d2e9b4a0c6f1e8d3b5a9c2f7e0d4b1a6c8e3f5d9b2a7c0e"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

A wrong, used or missing code is 212 "That recovery code is not valid" (401); repeated failures are blocked for a while. The token is also sent in X-FM-Data-Access-Token.

<a id="data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-recovery-codes"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/recovery-codes`

Makes a fresh set of ten recovery codes for the signed-in account, replacing any it had, and returns them once.

**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token); acts only on the session's own account.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/recovery-codes
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "codes": [
      "a1b2-c3d4-e5f6",
      "0f9e-8d7c-6b5a",
      "…"
    ],
    "remaining": 10
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey-register-options"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey/register/options`

Starts registering a passkey for the signed-in account: returns a challenge and the credential ids it already has.

**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; acts only on the session's own account.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/passkey/register/options
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "challenge": "Xw3pT9vK0mQ2rL7sZ1yB5nC8dF4gH6jA",
    "rpId": "data.example.com",
    "user": {
      "name": "Admin"
    },
    "excludeCredentials": []
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="data-api-sessions-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey-register"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey/register`

Finishes registering a passkey for the signed-in account and returns its credential id.

**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; the challenge must have been issued to the same account.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `response` | body | object | yes | The attestation: {attestationObject, clientDataJSON, challenge} |
| `label` | body | string | no | A name for the passkey, such as the device |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/passkey/register
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "response": {
    "attestationObject": "o2NmbXRkbm9uZWdhdHRTdG10oGhhdXRoRGF0YVi…",
    "clientDataJSON": "eyJ0eXBlIjoid2ViYXV0aG4uY3JlYXRlIi…",
    "challenge": "Xw3pT9vK0mQ2rL7sZ1yB5nC8dF4gH6jA"
  },
  "label": "MacBook"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "id": "AV3k9x2LmQ7rT1yZ"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

An expired or already used challenge, or an attestation that does not verify, is error 960.

<a id="data-api-sessions-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey`

Lists the signed-in account's passkeys, newest first.

**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; lists only the session's own account.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/passkey
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "passkeys": [
      {
        "id": "AV3k9x2LmQ7rT1yZ",
        "account": "Admin",
        "label": "MacBook",
        "created": "2026-10-01T09:12:44.120Z",
        "lastUsed": "2026-10-12T08:03:10.511Z"
      }
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

label and lastUsed are left out when not set.

<a id="data-api-sessions-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-passkey-credentialid"></a>

### `DELETE /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/passkey/{credentialId}`

Removes one of the signed-in account's own passkeys.

**Permissions:** A valid session token for the file; a credential id that isn't the session account's own is 9 "Not your passkey" (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `credentialId` | path | string | yes | The passkey's credential id |

**Example:**

```http
DELETE /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/passkey/AV3k9x2LmQ7rT1yZ
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "removed": true
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="data-api-metadata"></a>

## Data API: files, layouts and scripts

Information about the server and its hosted files, and the per-session global fields. productInfo and the database list need no sign-in; the rest take a session token as Authorization: Bearer {token}. Layouts, scripts, fields and value lists the account's privilege set can't use are left out, and a layout-scoped API token sees only its layouts. Replies use the {"response", "messages"} envelope.

Source: `packages/server/src/dataapi.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/productInfo`](#data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-productinfo) | Returns the server's name, version and build date, and the date and time formats it uses. |
| GET, HEAD | [`/fmi/data/openapi.json`](#data-api-metadata-get-head-fmi-data-openapi-json) | Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Data API and OData this server answers. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases`](#data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-databases) | Lists the hosted files, when the server lists them publicly. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts`](#data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts) | Lists the file's layouts in its order, in folders, with each layout's table. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}`](#data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout) | Returns a layout's field metadata, its portals' field metadata and the value lists its fields use. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/scripts`](#data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-scripts) | Lists the file's scripts in folders, as in the Scripts menu. |
| PATCH | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/globals`](#data-api-metadata-patch-fmi-data-version-databases-database-globals) | Sets global fields for this session only. |

<a id="data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-productinfo"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/productInfo`

Returns the server's name, version and build date, and the date and time formats it uses.

**Permissions:** None.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/productInfo
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "productInfo": {
      "name": "tabularius",
      "buildDate": "10/01/2026",
      "version": "0.1.0",
      "dateFormat": "MM/dd/yyyy",
      "timeFormat": "HH:mm:ss",
      "timeStampFormat": "MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss"
    }
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

version is Tabularius's package version; buildDate is the package file's modification date.

<a id="data-api-metadata-get-head-fmi-data-openapi-json"></a>

### `GET, HEAD /fmi/data/openapi.json`

Returns the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Data API and OData this server answers.

**Permissions:** None: no credentials are read, and nothing in it depends on a file or an account.

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/openapi.json
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "openapi": "3.1.0",
  "info": {
    "title": "tabularius Data API and OData",
    "version": "1"
  },
  "servers": [
    {
      "url": "https://fms.example.com"
    }
  ],
  "paths": {},
  "components": {}
}
```

Written from the route table in this reference and the response contract, not by hand: a test fails when a route here has no operation in it, or an operation has no route. Operations that FileMaker's own API does not have carry `x-tabularius-only`; a response schema read off the documented example, not checked key by key, carries `x-tabularius-inferred`. `servers` is this server's own address (the --public-url when one is set). For TypeScript types of the same description, run `tabularius api-types > tabularius-api.d.ts`. Any other method is 405 code 3. See docs/openapi.md.

<a id="data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-databases"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases`

Lists the hosted files, when the server lists them publicly.

**Permissions:** None: no credentials are read. Only on a server started with --list-files-publicly (TABULARIUS_LIST_FILES_PUBLICLY); otherwise 404 code 3, and a caller names the file in the address.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "databases": [
      {
        "name": "Contacts"
      },
      {
        "name": "Invoices"
      }
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts`

Lists the file's layouts in its order, in folders, with each layout's table.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Layouts the privilege set has no access to, and layouts outside a layout-scoped token's list, are left out.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "layouts": [
      {
        "name": "Invoices",
        "table": "Invoices"
      },
      {
        "name": "Reports",
        "isFolder": true,
        "folderLayoutNames": [
          {
            "name": "Monthly Totals",
            "table": "Invoices"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Empty folders are left out; layouts not in the file's order (made since) come last.

<a id="data-api-metadata-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}`

Returns a layout's field metadata, its portals' field metadata and the value lists its fields use.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). A layout the set can't use, or outside a layout-scoped token's list, is 105 "Layout … is missing" (500). Fields the set can't see, and value lists it has no access to, are left out. A masked field is listed, with result text whatever its type.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "fieldMetaData": [
      {
        "name": "Status",
        "type": "normal",
        "displayType": "editText",
        "result": "text",
        "global": false,
        "autoEnter": false,
        "fourDigitYear": false,
        "maxRepeat": 1,
        "maxCharacters": 0,
        "notEmpty": false,
        "numeric": false,
        "timeOfDay": false,
        "repetitionStart": 1,
        "repetitionEnd": 1,
        "repetitions": 1
      }
    ],
    "portalMetaData": {
      "LineItems": [
        {
          "name": "LineItems::Amount",
          "type": "normal",
          "displayType": "editText",
          "result": "number",
          "global": false,
          "autoEnter": false,
          "fourDigitYear": false,
          "maxRepeat": 1,
          "maxCharacters": 0,
          "notEmpty": false,
          "numeric": false,
          "timeOfDay": false,
          "repetitionStart": 1,
          "repetitionEnd": 1,
          "repetitions": 1
        }
      ]
    },
    "valueLists": [
      {
        "name": "Statuses",
        "type": "customList",
        "values": [
          {
            "value": "Open",
            "displayValue": "Open"
          },
          {
            "value": "Paid",
            "displayValue": "Paid"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

type is normal, calculation or summary; result is text, number, date, time, timeStamp or container. displayType is how the layout shows the field: editText, popupList, popupMenu, checkBox, radioButtons, calendar or secureText (a concealed edit box), and editText for a field not on the layout. Related fields on the layout appear as "TO::Field". valueLists is left out when the layout uses none; lists of related values are left out.

Lists the file's scripts in folders, as in the Scripts menu.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Scripts the privilege set can't run or see are left out.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/scripts
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "scripts": [

        "name": "Send Reminders",

      {
        "name": "-",
        "isFolder": false
```

<a id="data-api-metadata-patch-fmi-data-version-databases-database-globals"></a>

### `PATCH /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/globals`

Sets global fields for this session only.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Each field is set under the privilege set. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `globalFields` | body | object | yes | {"Table::Field": value}, each value a string or number |

**Example:**

```http
PATCH /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/globals
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "globalFields": {
    "Settings::gCurrency": "EUR"
  }
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

A missing or non-object globalFields is 958 (400); a value that is not a string or number is 960 (400).

<a id="data-api-records"></a>

## Data API: records, finds and scripts

Reading and writing records through a layout, finding, uploading to container fields and running scripts, at /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/…. Every route takes a session token as Authorization: Bearer {token} and runs with the account's privilege set: records it can't view are left out and fields it can't see are omitted. Record requests take script, script.prerequest and script.presort (each with a .param) and answer with scriptResult and scriptError; a script's error is reported there, not as an HTTP error. An explicitly tagged terminal privilege error adds tabularius:denial (operation, permission, safe explanation), with .prerequest or .presort suffixes for those phases. Get ( LastErrorDetail ) returns the same safe sentence while that error remains current; a handled error with final scriptError 0 adds no denial extension. recordId and modId are strings. FileMaker errors such as 101 (record missing), 102 (field missing), 105 (layout missing) and 306 (modId mismatch) come back with status 500.

Source: `packages/server/src/dataapi.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records`](#data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records) | Returns a range of records from the layout's table. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records`](#data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records) | Creates a record and returns its recordId and modId. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}`](#data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid) | Returns one record. |
| PATCH | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}`](#data-api-records-patch-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid) | Edits a record, and optionally its portal rows, and returns the new modId. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}`](#data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid) | Duplicates a record and returns the copy's recordId and modId. |
| DELETE | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}`](#data-api-records-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid) | Deletes a record. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/containers/{field}`](#data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-containers-field) | Uploads a file into a container field (repetition 1). |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/containers/{field}/{repetition}`](#data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-containers-field-repetition) | Uploads a file into one repetition of a container field. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/container-uploads/{field}`](#data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-container-uploads-field) | Starts a container upload in pieces (repetition 1). Not in FileMaker's Data API. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}`](#data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid) | Says how many bytes of an upload in pieces have arrived. Not in FileMaker's Data API. |
| PUT | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}`](#data-api-records-put-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid) | Sends the next piece of an upload in pieces, as raw bytes. Not in FileMaker's Data API. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}/finish`](#data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid-finish) | Puts the finished file of an upload in pieces into its container field. Not in FileMaker's Data API. |
| DELETE | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}`](#data-api-records-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid) | Stops an upload in pieces and forgets what arrived. Not in FileMaker's Data API. |
| DELETE | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/containers/{field}`](#data-api-records-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-containers-field) | Empties a container field (repetition 1). Not in FileMaker's Data API. |
| POST | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/_find`](#data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-find) | Finds records with one or more find requests and returns a range of the found set. |
| GET | [`/fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/script/{script}`](#data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-script-script) | Runs a script on a layout and returns its result. |

<a id="data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records`

Returns a range of records from the layout's table.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Records the privilege set can't view are left out; a masked field comes back as its stand-in, never its value. A read-only API token may read but not run scripts.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `_offset` | query | number | no | The first record, 1-based (default 1); a whole number of 1 or more, else 960 (400) |
| `_limit` | query | number | no | How many records (default 100); a whole number of 0 to 10,000 (`TABULARIUS_DATA_API_MAX_LIMIT`, 0 for no cap), else 960 (400); more is refused, not cut down |
| `_sort` | query | string | no | JSON array of {fieldName, sortOrder}; anything else is 960 (400) |
| `portal` | query | string | no | The portals to include, as a JSON array or a comma-separated list (default all) |
| `_offset.{portal}` | query | number | no | The first related row in that portal, 1-based |
| `_limit.{portal}` | query | number | no | How many related rows in that portal |
| `dateformats` | query | string | no | 2 for ISO 8601 dates; otherwise US (MM/DD/YYYY) |
| `script` | query | string | no | A script to run after the action; its result comes back as scriptResult and scriptError |
| `script.param` | query | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.prerequest` | query | string | no | A script to run before the action (scriptResult.prerequest, scriptError.prerequest) |
| `script.prerequest.param` | query | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.presort` | query | string | no | A script to run before sorting (scriptResult.presort, scriptError.presort) |
| `script.presort.param` | query | string | no | Its parameter |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records?_offset=1&_limit=2&_sort=%5B%7B%22fieldName%22%3A%22Number%22%2C%22sortOrder%22%3A%22descend%22%7D%5D
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "dataInfo": {
      "database": "Invoices",
      "layout": "Invoices",
      "table": "Invoices",
      "totalRecordCount": 812,
      "foundCount": 812,
      "returnedCount": 2
    },
    "data": [
      {
        "fieldData": {
          "Number": 812,
          "Customer": "Acme Ltd",
          "Status": "Open"
        },
        "portalData": {},
        "recordId": "812",
        "modId": "3"
      },
      {
        "fieldData": {
          "Number": 811,
          "Customer": "Brook & Co",
          "Status": "Paid"
        },
        "portalData": {},
        "recordId": "811",
        "modId": "0"
      }
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

When the layout has portals, each record's portalData holds their rows (each with recordId and modId) and portalDataInfo gives portalObjectName, database, table, foundCount and returnedCount for each. Records may also carry "updating" (fields showing a value from before the latest change) "styles" (text formatting by field) and "portalStyles" (the same for portal rows), which FileMaker's Data API does not have.

<a id="data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records`

Creates a record and returns its recordId and modId.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow creating records in the table and editing the fields given. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `fieldData` | body | object | no | Field names and values (may be empty) |
| `portalData` | body | object | no | {"Portal": [{"TO::Field": value}]}: each row makes one related record. A row may not carry a recordId. |
| `script` | body | string | no | A script to run after the action; its result comes back as scriptResult and scriptError |
| `script.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.prerequest` | body | string | no | A script to run before the action (scriptResult.prerequest, scriptError.prerequest) |
| `script.prerequest.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.presort` | body | string | no | A script to run before sorting (scriptResult.presort, scriptError.presort) |
| `script.presort.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "fieldData": {
    "Customer": "Acme Ltd",
    "Status": "Open"
  }
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "recordId": "813",
    "modId": "0"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

An unknown field is 102 (500). Invalid JSON is 960 (400). With portalData the record and its related records are made together as one transaction: if any portal row is refused (no privilege, a bad field), nothing is created. A portalData that is not an object of arrays of rows, or a row with a recordId, is 960 (400). The reply is the new record's own recordId and modId; related records do not change its modId.

<a id="data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}`

| `script.prerequest.param` | query | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.presort` | query | string | no | A script to run before sorting (scriptResult.presort, scriptError.presort) |

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {

      "layout": "Invoices",
      "table": "Invoices",
      "totalRecordCount": 812,
      "foundCount": 1,
      "returnedCount": 1
    },
    "data": [
      {
        "fieldData": {
          "Number": "812",
          "Customer": "Acme Ltd",
          "Status": "Open"
        },
        "portalData": {},
        "recordId": "812",
        "modId": "3"
      }
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {

    }
  ]
}
```

A missing record is 101 (500).

<a id="data-api-records-patch-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid"></a>

### `PATCH /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}`

Edits a record, and optionally its portal rows, and returns the new modId.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow editing the record and fields. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `recordId` | path | string | yes | The record's recordId (an integer) |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `fieldData` | body | object | no | Field names and new values; fieldData.deleteRelated ("portal.recordId" or an array of them) deletes related rows |
| `modId` | body | string | no | When given, the edit is refused with 306 unless it matches the record's modId |
| `portalData` | body | object | no | {"Portal": [{"recordId": …, "TO::Field": value}]} to edit or add related rows |
| `styles` | body | object | no | Text formatting runs by field, for fields also in fieldData (a Tabularius addition) |
| `portalStyles` | body | object | no | Text formatting runs for portal rows: portal, then the row's recordId, then "TO::Field"; each field must have a value in that row of portalData (a Tabularius addition) |
| `script` | body | string | no | A script to run after the action; its result comes back as scriptResult and scriptError |
| `script.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.prerequest` | body | string | no | A script to run before the action (scriptResult.prerequest, scriptError.prerequest) |
| `script.prerequest.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.presort` | body | string | no | A script to run before sorting (scriptResult.presort, scriptError.presort) |
| `script.presort.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |

**Example:**

```http
PATCH /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records/812
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "fieldData": {
    "Status": "Paid"
  },
  "modId": "3"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "modId": "4"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

A stale modId is 306 (500). styles for a field without a value in fieldData, or not valid, is 960 (400); portalStyles for a row not in portalData is 960 (400). When portal rows were added, the reply also has newPortalRecordInfo, an array of {tableName, recordId, modId} for each related record made.

<a id="data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-containers-field"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/containers/{field}`

Uploads a file into a container field (repetition 1).

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow editing the field. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `recordId` | path | string | yes | The record's recordId (an integer) |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `field` | path | string | yes | The container field |
| `modId` | query | string | no | When given, the upload is refused with 306 unless it matches the record's modId |
| `upload` | body | file | yes | multipart/form-data part named "upload" holding the file |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records/812/containers/Scan
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=X

--X
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="invoice.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf

(file bytes)
--X--
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Uploads are capped at 1 GB (960, 413). A body that is not multipart/form-data, or has no "upload" part, is 960 (400); an empty part is 10 (400).

<a id="data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-containers-field-repetition"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/containers/{field}/{repetition}`

Uploads a file into one repetition of a container field.
