The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow editing the field. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `recordId` | path | string | yes | The record's recordId (an integer) |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `field` | path | string | yes | The container field |
| `repetition` | path | number | yes | The repetition, from 1 |
| `modId` | query | string | no | When given, the upload is refused with 306 unless it matches the record's modId |
| `upload` | body | file | yes | multipart/form-data part named "upload" holding the file |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records/812/containers/Scan/2
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=X

--X
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="upload"; filename="page2.pdf"
Content-Type: application/pdf

(file bytes)
--X--
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

A repetition that is not a whole number of at least 1 is 960 "Invalid repetition" (400). Same limits as the route without a repetition.

<a id="data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-container-uploads-field"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/container-uploads/{field}`

Starts a container upload in pieces (repetition 1). Not in FileMaker's Data API.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow editing the field, checked when the upload starts and again when it finishes. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `recordId` | path | string | yes | The record's recordId (an integer) |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `field` | path | string | yes | The container field |
| `filename` | body | string | no | The file's name |
| `mime` | body | string | no | Its type (application/octet-stream when not given) |
| `size` | body | number | yes | Its size in bytes, 1 to 1,073,741,824 |
| `sha256` | body | string | no | The file's SHA-256 in hexadecimal; when given, checked at the finish (a file that differs is refused and the upload dropped) |
| `modId` | body | string | no | The record's modId; a mismatch is 306 when the upload starts, and again when it finishes |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records/812/container-uploads/Scan
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"filename":"scan.pdf","mime":"application/pdf","size":104857600}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "uploadId": "q3Zr8T1xH0m5Yw2kLd9aVcJb",
    "size": 104857600,
    "received": 0,
    "maxPiece": 67108864
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Add /{repetition} for another repetition, and ?portal=<name>&portalRecordId=<id> for a portal row, as for a single upload. An account may have 4 uploads going in a file (a fifth is 212, 429) and all accounts together 8 GiB of declared sizes (413); a size over 1 GiB is 413, a size that is not a whole number of 1 or more is 400. Uploads wait in TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_TMP, are dropped after TABULARIUS_UPLOAD_IDLE_HOURS (24) without a byte arriving (asking how far one has got does not count), and do not survive a restart.

<a id="data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}`

Says how many bytes of an upload in pieces have arrived. Not in FileMaker's Data API.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Only the account that started the upload sees it; for anyone else it is 404.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `uploadId` | path | string | yes | The uploadId the start answered |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/container-uploads/q3Zr8T1xH0m5Yw2kLd9aVcJb
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "uploadId": "q3Zr8T1xH0m5Yw2kLd9aVcJb",
    "size": 104857600,
    "received": 4194304,
    "maxPiece": 67108864
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

After a dropped connection, ask here where to go on from.

<a id="data-api-records-put-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid"></a>

### `PUT /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}`

Sends the next piece of an upload in pieces, as raw bytes. Not in FileMaker's Data API.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Only the account that started the upload. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `uploadId` | path | string | yes | The uploadId the start answered |
| `offset` | query | number | yes | Where the piece starts: the received count the last answer gave; anything else is 409, which says where to start |

**Example:**

```http
PUT /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/container-uploads/q3Zr8T1xH0m5Yw2kLd9aVcJb?offset=0
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

<4194304 bytes>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "uploadId": "q3Zr8T1xH0m5Yw2kLd9aVcJb",
    "size": 104857600,
    "received": 4194304,
    "maxPiece": 67108864
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

A piece is at most maxPiece (64 MiB) and may not run past the declared size (413). What arrived of a piece that was cut off stays, so a retry asks the GET above and goes on from there. A second piece sent while one is still arriving is 409. Unlike other writes, a piece does not hold up the session's other writes.

<a id="data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid-finish"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}/finish`

Puts the finished file of an upload in pieces into its container field. Not in FileMaker's Data API.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow editing the field, checked when the upload starts and again when it finishes. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `uploadId` | path | string | yes | The uploadId the start answered |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/container-uploads/q3Zr8T1xH0m5Yw2kLd9aVcJb/finish
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

Every byte must have arrived (409 and the received count otherwise), and the SHA-256, if one was given, must match (960, HTTP 422; the upload is then dropped). A modId that no longer matches is 306, and the upload is dropped: the record's modId only moves on, so it could never be put in.

<a id="data-api-records-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-container-uploads-uploadid"></a>

### `DELETE /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/container-uploads/{uploadId}`

Stops an upload in pieces and forgets what arrived. Not in FileMaker's Data API.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Only the account that started the upload. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `uploadId` | path | string | yes | The uploadId the start answered |

**Example:**

```http
DELETE /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/container-uploads/q3Zr8T1xH0m5Yw2kLd9aVcJb
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="data-api-records-delete-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-recordid-containers-field"></a>

### `DELETE /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{recordId}/containers/{field}`

Empties a container field (repetition 1). Not in FileMaker's Data API.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must allow editing the field. A read-only API token is refused writes and scripts with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `recordId` | path | string | yes | The record's recordId (an integer) |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `field` | path | string | yes | The container field |
| `modId` | query | string | no | When given, the delete is refused with 306 unless it matches the record's modId |

**Example:**

```http
DELETE /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records/812/containers/Scan
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {},
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

To empty one repetition, add it to the path: …/containers/{field}/{repetition} (a whole number of 1 or more, else 960 "Invalid repetition", 400). A stale modId is 306 (500).

<a id="data-api-records-post-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-find"></a>

### `POST /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/_find`

Finds records with one or more find requests and returns a range of the found set.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). Records the privilege set can't view are left out; a masked field comes back as its stand-in and can't be searched or sorted by (an error). Allowed for a read-only API token, but not with scripts.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `query` | body | array of object | yes | Find requests: field names to criteria; "omit": "true" makes a request omit |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | {fieldName, sortOrder}; anything else is 960 (400) |
| `offset` | body | number | no | The first record, 1-based (default 1); a string of digits works too; anything but a whole number of 1 or more is 960 (400) |
| `limit` | body | number | no | How many records (default 100); a whole number of 0 to 10,000 (`TABULARIUS_DATA_API_MAX_LIMIT`, 0 for no cap), else 960 (400); more is refused, not cut down |
| `portal` | body | array of string | no | The portals to include |
| `offset.{portal}` | body | number | no | The first related row in that portal |
| `limit.{portal}` | body | number | no | How many related rows in that portal |
| `dateformats` | body | string | no | 2 for ISO 8601 dates |
| `script` | body | string | no | A script to run after the action; its result comes back as scriptResult and scriptError |
| `script.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.prerequest` | body | string | no | A script to run before the action (scriptResult.prerequest, scriptError.prerequest) |
| `script.prerequest.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |
| `script.presort` | body | string | no | A script to run before sorting (scriptResult.presort, scriptError.presort) |
| `script.presort.param` | body | string | no | Its parameter |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/_find
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": [
    {
      "Status": "==Open"
    },
    {
      "Customer": "Acme",
      "omit": "true"
    }
  ],
  "sort": [
    {
      "fieldName": "Number",
      "sortOrder": "ascend"
    }
  ],
  "limit": 1
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "dataInfo": {
      "database": "Invoices",
      "layout": "Invoices",
      "table": "Invoices",
      "totalRecordCount": 812,
      "foundCount": 37,
      "returnedCount": 1
    },
    "data": [
      {
        "fieldData": {
          "Number": 640,
          "Customer": "Brook & Co",
          "Status": "Open"
        },
        "portalData": {},
        "recordId": "640",
        "modId": "1"
      }
    ]
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

A missing or empty query is 10 "Requested data is missing" (400). No matches is 401 "No records match the request" (HTTP 400). Find criteria support ! and !text for duplicate values, // for today (also in ranges), ? for invalid nonempty dates, times and timestamps, # for one digit, and ~text for relaxed accent, kana and Unicode compatibility matching. Duplicate values are determined before other criteria and omit requests. Text duplicates compare the first 100 characters; repeated values must occur in distinct records. Quoted or backslash-escaped wildcards are literal. Unsupported criteria (for example, a bare ~ or a container duplicate find) return FileMaker code 400 with HTTP 400.

<a id="data-api-records-get-fmi-data-version-databases-database-layouts-layout-script-script"></a>

### `GET /fmi/data/{version}/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/script/{script}`

Runs a script on a layout and returns its result.

**Permissions:** A Data API session: Authorization: Bearer {token} (or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a sign-in or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file whose surfaces include fmrest; a missing, unknown or idle (15 minutes) token, or one whose account has been disabled, is 952 (401). The account's privilege set is read on every request and must still have the fmrest extended privilege (fmapp or fmwebdirect for a web-client session), else 9 (401). A session that owes a password change is refused with 212 (403). The privilege set must be able to run the script; a script it can't run or that doesn't exist comes back as a scriptError, not an HTTP error. A read-only API token is refused with 9 (403).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | path | string | yes | vLatest, v1 or v2 (all answer the same) |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | The layout to work through |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a session token from POST …/sessions, or a scoped API token (ohbt_…). The X-FM-Data-Access-Token header is accepted in its place. |
| `script` | path | string | yes | The script's name |
| `script.param` | query | string | no | The script parameter |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/script/Send%20Reminders?script.param=overdue
Authorization: Bearer <session-token>
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "response": {
    "scriptResult": "12 sent",
    "scriptError": "0"
  },
  "messages": [
    {
      "code": "0",
      "message": "OK"
    }
  ]
}
```

A missing script answers 200 with scriptError "104". Tagged terminal privilege errors optionally add tabularius:denial; handled errors do not. Each outward Data API request, web request or interactive script run, and MCP tool invocation audits only its first tagged refused check, even if a script handles it. The owning file records captured effective-account and policy metadata after cleanup and rollback. Hidden objects, filtering and redaction create no privilege-denied events. Repeats are suppressed for ten minutes, with 500 keys per file and separate admission and append-attempt budgets of 60/minute each; immediate, deferred and retried writes share the append budget. Diagnostics captured during trials are suppressed, while already captured production refusals wait for trial release. Deferred writes expire after ten minutes; failed appends get at most three attempts. Aggregate failure/drop counters contain no exception text. This is a sampled, process-local history, not a count of attempts or durable exactly-once delivery. Metadata and configuration names can contain personal text. Scheduled/background jobs and other protocol adapters remain deferred; policy fingerprints are not historical snapshots.

<a id="web-client"></a>

## Web client

The browser app is served under /app/, and it reads layout designs and runs buttons through a JSON API under /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}. The API takes the same session token as the Data API (records themselves are read and written through /fmi/data/…), and everything runs with the account's privilege set. Terminal script privilege errors optionally include denial (operation, permission, safe explanation) alongside the existing error code; handled errors produce no retrospective error toast. Interactive runs audit their first tagged refusal only after terminal cleanup, including abandonment after a dialog or pause timeout. Errors answer {"error":{"code":N,"message":"…"}}: 401 code 952 for a missing or expired token, 404 code 802 for a file that isn't hosted, 405 code 3 for a sub-route called with anything but POST (the …/prefs routes take GET and PUT), and HTTP 400 for store and privilege errors (105 for a layout the account can't use).

Source: `packages/server/src/webclient.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET, HEAD | [`/favicon.ico`](#web-client-get-head-favicon-ico) | Redirects to the app's icon, /app/favicon.svg, which browsers ask for on their own. |
| GET, HEAD | [`/fmi/webd/{database}`](#web-client-get-head-fmi-webd-database) | A WebDirect-style link: redirects to the web client on that file, carrying the script to run once the person has signed in. |
| GET | [`/app`](#web-client-get-app) | Redirects to /app/. |
| GET | [`/app/{path...}`](#web-client-get-app-path) | Serves the browser app's files (packages/web); /app/ is index.html. |
| GET | [`/next`](#web-client-get-next) | Redirects to /next/. |
| GET | [`/next/`](#web-client-get-next) | The alternative client's page (packages/web/next/index.html): tables as collections, built from the data rather than the layouts. Its modules and styles load from /app/next/. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/images/{database}/{id}`](#web-client-get-tabularius-images-database-id) | A picture from the file's image library, for <img> tags. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts`](#web-client-get-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts) | The layout menu: layouts in the file's order and folders, the Scripts menu, and File Options. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}`](#web-client-get-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout) | A layout's design, theme styles, field types, value lists, signed image URLs and portals, for drawing it. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/view`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-view) | What a layout shows differently per record: hide conditions, tooltips, placeholders, conditional formatting, calculated labels, merge fields, active segments and web viewer URLs, worked out for each record (and portal row). |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-records) | A page of records by id, in the order given (a script's found set), or sorted. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/foundset`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-foundset) | The rows of a found-set portal (a portal on the layout's own table) for the window's found set, a page at a time. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/groups`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-groups) | Sub-summary groups of a sorted found set: for each sort field, the runs of records it groups, with the layout's summary fields over each run. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/charts`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-charts) | Chart data for the records shown: each chart's titles, categories and series values, from the current record, the found set or related records. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/menus`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-menus) | The custom menu bar in use for a record: each menu's title and items, with title and "install when" formulas worked out. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/button`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-button) | Runs a button's script (or its one step), a script trigger, a File Options trigger, a custom menu item, a Scripts menu entry, an installed OnTimer script, or a Records/Edit menu command, as the account. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/value-list`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-value-list) | The items of a value list as this account may use it, for a page that draws its own pop-up menus (`tabularius.valueList(name)` in a web viewer page). |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/explain`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-explain) | Explain This Value without the assistant: the formula of a calculated field with every value it read, or the relationship a related field or portal row follows. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/history`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-history) | A record's history: who changed what and when, from where (web client, Data API, OData, MCP, a script, ...), newest first, with the audit entry behind each change. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/revert`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-revert) | Puts back what one audit entry changed: an edit's fields get their old values, a created record is deleted, a deleted record is made again. Logged as a change that says which entry it reverts. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/refresh`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-refresh) | Fresh display records, layout formulas, charts and found-set portal rows, without committing or changing the supplied found-set order. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/position`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-position) | Where a record is in the window's found set, so the window can stay on it after a sort moves it to a page not loaded yet. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/index`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-index) | A field's index for auto-complete: its values starting with a prefix. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/export`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-export) | Export Records: the found set's chosen fields as a file to download (CSV, tab-separated text or an Excel workbook). |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/import`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-import) | Import Records: a CSV, tab-separated, Excel or FileMaker XML file the person picked, previewed, planned (columns matched to fields) or imported into the layout's table. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/undo-import`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-undo-import) | Takes back an import made with `columns`: deletes the records it added and puts back what it overwrote, leaving records changed since. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/ai-replace`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-ai-replace) | Replace Field Contents with AI: the field gets, in each record of the found set, what the assistant writes from an instruction and that record's visible values; journaled so it can be undone. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}/file`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-runs-id-file) | Answers a button script that is waiting: a file for Insert File, Continue/Cancel for Pause, a button for Show Custom Dialog, an order for Sort Records, what Insert from Device captured, or the device's location; returns the rest of the run. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/runs/stop`](#web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-runs-stop) | Stops the scripts this session is running in the file, as Esc does in FileMaker: each halts at its next step, or at once in a timed pause. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/prefs`](#web-client-get-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-prefs) | The signed-in account's own saved finds, saved sorts and recent records in this file. |
| PUT | [`/tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/prefs/{key}`](#web-client-put-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-prefs-key) | Keeps one of the account's saved finds, saved sorts or recent records, replacing it; a null or missing value clears it. |

<a id="web-client-get-head-favicon-ico"></a>

### `GET, HEAD /favicon.ico`

Redirects to the app's icon, /app/favicon.svg, which browsers ask for on their own.

**Permissions:** None.

**Example:**

```http
GET /favicon.ico
```

Response `302`:

```text
(empty body; Location: /app/favicon.svg)
```

Served directly and cached for a day.

<a id="web-client-get-head-fmi-webd-database"></a>

### `GET, HEAD /fmi/webd/{database}`

A WebDirect-style link: redirects to the web client on that file, carrying the script to run once the person has signed in.

**Permissions:** None to follow the link. The script runs only for an account whose privilege set has the fmurlscript extended privilege (403 code 9 otherwise, shown to the person).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name (URL-encoded; a malformed escape is 400) |
| `script` | query | string | no | Script to run, by name (up to 256 characters) |
| `param` | query | string | no | Its script parameter, as text (up to 10,000 characters) |
| `$name` | query | string | no | A local variable the script starts with (up to 20, each up to 10,000 characters; $$ names are ignored) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/webd/Orders?script=Open%20order&param=1042&%24region=EU
```

Response `302`:

```text
(empty body; Location: /app/?db=Orders&script=Open+order&param=1042&%24region=EU)
```

Nothing else on the query string is passed on. Cache-Control: no-store. The web client takes the script out of its address once it has run, so a reload does not run it again.

<a id="web-client-get-app"></a>

### `GET /app`

Redirects to /app/.

**Permissions:** None.

**Example:**

```http
GET /app
```

Response `301`:

```text
(empty body; Location: /app/)
```

The method is not checked.

<a id="web-client-get-app-path"></a>

### `GET /app/{path...}`

Serves the browser app's files (packages/web); /app/ is index.html.

**Permissions:** None: the app signs in through the Data API.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | path | string | no | A file under packages/web; empty for index.html |

**Example:**

```http
GET /app/src/layout.ts
```

Response `200`:

```text
(the module as JavaScript: TypeScript types are stripped as it is served)
```

Only .html, .css, .js, .ts, .svg, .png and .webmanifest files are served, with Cache-Control: no-cache, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Referrer-Policy: no-referrer; anything else, or a path outside the folder, is 404. HTML pages carry X-Frame-Options: DENY and Content-Security-Policy: frame-src 'self' about: data: blob:; frame-ancestors 'none', so no other site can frame them. The method is not checked.
