### `GET /next`

Redirects to /next/.

**Permissions:** None.

**Example:**

```http
GET /next
```

Response `301`:

```text
(empty body; Location: /next/)
```

The method is not checked.

<a id="web-client-get-next"></a>

### `GET /next/`

The alternative client's page (packages/web/next/index.html): tables as collections, built from the data rather than the layouts. Its modules and styles load from /app/next/.

**Permissions:** None: the client signs in through the Data API, and shares the sign-in with /app/ in the same browser tab.

**Example:**

```http
GET /next/
```

Response `200`:

```text
(the page)
```

Served as /app/ files are, with the same headers. The method is not checked.

<a id="web-client-get-tabularius-images-database-id"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/images/{database}/{id}`

A picture from the file's image library, for <img> tags.

**Permissions:** None beyond the signature: the URL is signed by the server (the layout route hands these out), so no session token is needed.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | Image id |
| `sig` | query | string | yes | Signature from the layout route's `images` |
| `exp` | query | number | no | Expiry (Unix seconds), when the server signs URLs with one |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/images/Invoices/12?sig=Qm9n…
```

Response `200`:

```text
(the image bytes, with its content type, Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400 and a Content-Security-Policy that keeps SVG from running scripts)
```

A wrong or expired signature, or an image that isn't there, answers 404 with no body.

<a id="web-client-get-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts`

The layout menu: layouts in the file's order and folders, the Scripts menu, and File Options.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Layouts the privilege set has no access to are left out; scripts it can't run, or not included in the menu, are left out of `scripts`.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "database": "Invoices",
  "account": "Admin",
  "scripts": [
    {
      "name": "New Invoice",
      "id": 3
    },
    {
      "name": "Reports",
      "items": [
        {
          "name": "Monthly Totals",
          "id": 7
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "layouts": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Invoices",
      "kind": "item",
      "depth": 0,
      "open": true
    },
    {
      "id": 4,
      "name": "Lists",
      "kind": "folder",
      "depth": 0,
      "open": false
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "name": "Invoice List",
      "kind": "item",
      "depth": 1,
      "open": true
    }
  ],
  "openLayout": "Invoices",
  "onFirstWindowOpen": true
}
```

Optional keys appear only when they apply: openLayout (File Options' layout, when it can be opened), onFirstWindowOpen / onLastWindowClose (the file has those triggers), customMenus (the file has custom menu sets), menuCommands (when the privilege set's available menu commands are not "all"). The method is not checked.

<a id="web-client-get-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}`

A layout's design, theme styles, field types, value lists, signed image URLs and portals, for drawing it.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. The layout must be one the privilege set can use (else error 105). Fields the account can't see are left out of `fields`; view-only ones are marked readOnly; a masked field is listed as masked and readOnly (its records carry the stand-in); value lists it can't use are left out.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "database": "Invoices",
  "layout": {
    "name": "Invoices",
    "id": 1,
    "occurrence": "Invoices",
    "table": "Invoices",
    "file": "Invoices"
  },
  "design": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Invoices",
    "tableOccurrenceId": 1065089,
    "width": 640,
    "themeId": 2,
    "style": {},
    "parts": [
      {
        "kind": "body",
        "kindId": 4,
        "top": 0,
        "height": 400,
        "style": {}
      }
    ],
    "objects": []
  },
  "theme": {
    "id": 2,
    "name": "Apex Blue",
    "defaults": {},
    "styles": []
  },
  "fields": {
    "Invoices": [
      {
        "name": "Number",
        "type": "number",
        "calculated": false,
        "summary": false,
        "global": false
      },
      {
        "name": "Customer",
        "type": "text",
        "calculated": false,
        "summary": false,
        "global": false
      }
    ]
  },
  "valueLists": {
    "1": [
      "Open",
      "Paid",
      "Overdue"
    ]
  },
  "images": {
    "1": "/tabularius/images/Invoices/1?sig=Qm9n…"
  },
  "portals": [],
  "layouts": {
    "1": "Invoices",
    "2": "Invoice List"
  }
}
```

Each portal in `portals` is marked foundSet: true when it is on the layout's own table occurrence (it lists the window's found set; its rows come from …/foundset), or create: true when the account may add a related record from its empty last row. Also, when they apply: valueListLabels (lists showing a second field), recordValueLists (lists of related values, given per record by …/view), pageSetup, canSeeDesign: true (the account may see formulas, so Explain This Value is offered; see …/explain), and sortLists (names of the value lists the Sort dialog can order by, those the account may see, not lists of related values). A request that sends X-Tabularius-Window (a JSON {device, width, height, contentWidth, contentHeight, screenWidth, screenHeight, scale, orientation}, under 400 characters) keeps it with the session, so Get ( Device ), Get ( WindowWidth ) and the like, in hide conditions and scripts, answer for the person's screen; this applies to every …/layouts route. Only the theme styles the layout uses are sent. A layout with no design answers 404 code 105. The method is not checked.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-view"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/view`

What a layout shows differently per record: hide conditions, tooltips, placeholders, conditional formatting, calculated labels, merge fields, active segments and web viewer URLs, worked out for each record (and portal row).

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Records the account can't view are skipped; merge fields naming a field it can't see show "<No Access>".

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `mode` | body | string | no | "browse" (default) or "find"; Find mode answers one `find` result with no records |
| `view` | body | string | no | form, list or table, for Get ( LayoutViewState ) |
| `foundCount` | body | number | no | For Get ( FoundCount ) |
| `totalCount` | body | number | no | For Get ( TotalRecordCount ) |
| `records` | body | array of object | no | [{id, number}]: the records shown (up to 200), with their record numbers; absent answers `find` |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/view
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"mode":"browse","view":"form","foundCount":1,"totalCount":1,"records":[{"id":7,"number":1}]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "records": {
    "7": {
      "hidden": [],
      "tooltips": {},
      "placeholders": {}
    }
  }
}
```

Each record's entry has hidden, tooltips and placeholders, and when there are any: styles (object id → indexes of conditions that are true), labels, merges, active, web, valueLists / valueListLabels (related value lists), rows (per portal, per row record id). With mode "find" or no `records`, the answer is {"find": {…}} with the same keys.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-records"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records`

A page of records by id, in the order given (a script's found set), or sorted.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Only records the account can view are returned and counted; field access applies.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | yes | The found set's record ids |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}]: the same records in this order |
| `offset` | body | number | no | 1-based, default 1 |
| `limit` | body | number | no | Default 50, at most 500 |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"ids":[9,7,8],"offset":1,"limit":2}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "fieldData": {
        "Number": 1009,
        "Customer": "Acme"
      },
      "portalData": {},
      "recordId": "9",
      "modId": "2"
    },
    {
      "fieldData": {
        "Number": 1007,
        "Customer": "Globex"
      },
      "portalData": {},
      "recordId": "7",
      "modId": "0"
    }
  ],
  "foundCount": 3,
  "totalCount": 120
}
```

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-foundset"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/foundset`

The rows of a found-set portal (a portal on the layout's own table) for the window's found set, a page at a time.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Only records the account can view are listed, and portal fields it can't see are left out.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |
| `portal` | body | string | yes | The portal's name, as the layout route lists it with foundSet: true |
| `offset` | body | number | no | 1-based, default 1 |
| `limit` | body | number | no | Default 1000, at most 1000 |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoice%20List/foundset
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"portal":"Invoices","ids":[9,7,8],"offset":1,"limit":2}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "rows": [
    {
      "recordId": "9",
      "modId": "2",
      "Invoices::Number": 1009
    },
    {
      "recordId": "7",
      "modId": "0",
      "Invoices::Number": 1007
    }
  ],
  "count": 3
}
```

Only the visible page is asked for: the web client loads a found-set portal's rows as they scroll into view, not all at once. count is the size of the whole found set (the viewable records of `ids` or of the find). The rows come in the order of `ids`, or of `sort`. styles (text formatting by row id, then field) is added when rows carry any. A portal name that isn't a found-set portal of the layout answers {"rows": [], "count": 0}; no portal name is 400 code 960.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-groups"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/groups`

Sub-summary groups of a sorted found set: for each sort field, the runs of records it groups, with the layout's summary fields over each run.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Only records the account can view, and only sort fields it can see.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |
| `fields` | body | array of string | yes | The fields to group by, outermost first |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoice%20List/groups
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"sort":[{"fieldName":"Customer","sortOrder":"ascend"}],"fields":["Customer"]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "groups": [
    [
      {
        "start": 0,
        "count": 2,
        "values": {}
      },
      {
        "start": 2,
        "count": 1,
        "values": {}
      }
    ]
  ]
}
```

No sort or no fields answers {"groups": []}. A field not on the layout is error 102.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-charts"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/charts`

Chart data for the records shown: each chart's titles, categories and series values, from the current record, the found set or related records.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Formulas naming a field the account can't see give no values, and a masked field can't be charted by (it is missing); only records it can view are used.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |
| `records` | body | array of number | no | Records shown (up to 50); absent: one entry with no record |
| `view` | body | string | no | form, list or table |
| `foundCount` | body | number | no | For Get ( FoundCount ) |
| `totalCount` | body | number | no | For Get ( TotalRecordCount ) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Dashboard/charts
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"records":[7]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "records": {}
}
```

Records map to chart object ids. A series may also have x and sizes; a chart may have xTitle, yTitle, yMin, yMax. The found set is capped at 5,000 records. Charts in portals are not drawn. A layout with no charts answers {"records": {}}.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-menus"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/menus`

The custom menu bar in use for a record: each menu's title and items, with title and "install when" formulas worked out.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `menuSet` | body | number | no | The set an Install Menu Set step put in place (1: standard menus); else the layout's own, else the file's default |
| `recordId` | body | number | no | The current record |
| `mode` | body | string | no | browse (default) or find |
| `view` | body | string | no | form (default), list or table |
| `foundCount` | body | number | no | For Get ( FoundCount ) |
| `totalCount` | body | number | no | For Get ( TotalRecordCount ) |
| `number` | body | number | no | For Get ( RecordNumber ) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/menus
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"mode":"browse","recordId":7}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "menus": [
    {
      "title": "Edit",
      "items": [
        {
          "kind": "command",
          "title": "Undo",
          "command": "Undo"
        },
        {
          "kind": "command",
          "title": "Mark Paid",
          "run": [
            12,
            1
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

With FileMaker's standard menus the answer is {"standard": true, "menus": []}. Items may carry run ([menu id, item index], for …/button's menuItem), shortcut, builtin and items (submenus).

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-button"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/button`

Runs a button's script (or its one step), a script trigger, a File Options trigger, a custom menu item, a Scripts menu entry, an installed OnTimer script, or a Records/Edit menu command, as the account.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. The script must be one the privilege set can run (error 9); a Scripts menu script must be listed in the menu (error 3); Replace Field Contents with a calculation needs [Full Access] (403 code 9). Record and field access apply to what the script does.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `objectId` | body | number | no | The button (or object with the trigger) |
| `trigger` | body | string | no | A script trigger event (OnRecordLoad, OnObjectKeystroke, …); OnFirstWindowOpen / OnLastWindowClose without objectId run File Options' scripts |
| `menuItem` | body | array of number | no | [menu id, item index] of a custom menu item in the set in use |
| `menuSet` | body | number | no | The installed menu set, for menuItem |
| `scriptId` | body | number | no | A script from the Scripts menu |
| `timer` | body | string | no | The timer id an Install OnTimer Script action gave this session |
| `command` | body | string | no | Duplicate Record, Omit Record, Show Omitted Only, Delete Record, Delete All Records, Omit Multiple, Replace Field Contents, Relookup Field Contents, Copy Record, Replace All, Save Records as PDF, Constrain Found Set or Extend Found Set; with its options (count, field, value, replaceWith, serial, calculation, find, replace, fields, matchCase, wholeWords, currentRecord, name, records, requests) |
| `recordId` | body | number | no | The current record |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |
| `mode` | body | string | no | browse (default) or find |
| `view` | body | string | no | form (default), list or table |
| `totalCount` | body | number | no | For Get ( TotalRecordCount ) |
| `row` | body | object | no | {portal, recordId}: a button in a portal row evaluates its parameter there |
| `panel` | body | object | no | {current, target} for OnPanelSwitch |
| `keystroke` | body | string | no | For OnObjectKeystroke / OnLayoutKeystroke, with modifierKeys (number) |
| `requests` | body | array of object | no | Find mode's requests [{criteria: {field: text}, omit}] |
| `preview` | body | boolean | no | The window is in Preview mode |
| `window` | body | object | no | {id, name, style?, layout?}: the window the run starts in (style document, floating, dialog or card) |
| `windows` | body | array of object | no | Every window the person has open, frontmost last (the last 50), in the same form, so Close Window in a later run closes a card and shows the window behind it |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/button
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"objectId":44,"recordId":7,"mode":"browse"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "script": "Go to List",
  "result": "",
  "error": 0,
  "layout": "Invoice List",
  "foundSet": [
    7,
    8,
    9
  ],
  "recordId": 7,
  "mode": "browse",
  "actions": []
}
```

A script that reaches Insert File without a path, Pause/Resume Script, Show Custom Dialog, Sort Records with a dialog, Insert from Index, Insert from Device or a step that needs the device's location stops and answers {"script", "waiting": {"run", "step": "Insert File" | "Pause" | "Dialog" | "Sort" | "Index" | "Device" | "Location", …}, "actions"} (Device also gives type, and camera when the step names one; Index gives field and values, the index to pick from; Pause, Dialog, Sort and Index also give the window: layout, foundSet, sort, recordId, mode); answer it with …/runs/{id}/file. A finished run (or a Pause, Dialog or Sort wait) adds active (where the script left the cursor: {objectId, portal?, row?, selection?}, or null for out of every field) when the script moved it. A run that opened or closed windows adds window (the window it ended in: {id, name, style, height?, width?, top?, left?, dimParent?, closeButton?, untouched?}; a card window dims the one behind it and has a close control; untouched means the window came to the front as the person had it, so the client keeps its own state of it) and closed (the ids of the windows Close Window closed, in order). A script can run Perform Script by name from the Scripts menu's scripts and from buttons as before; the windows it opens are the client's to draw. An unanswered run is canceled after 10 minutes. A script error gives {"script", "result": "", "error": code, "message", "actions": []}. Replace Field Contents, Replace All, Delete Record and Delete All Records add "undo": {id, summary, kind} (replace or delete) for /tabularius/cleanup/…/undo; Replace All that changed nothing adds "replaced": 0. Nothing to run answers 400 code 3; a missing script 404 code 104.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-value-list"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/value-list`

The items of a value list as this account may use it, for a page that draws its own pop-up menus (`tabularius.valueList(name)` in a web viewer page).

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. The privilege set must be able to use the value list (403 code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `name` | body | string | yes | The value list's name |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/value-list
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"name":"Statuses"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "values": [
    "Open",
    "Paid",
    "Overdue"
  ]
}
```

`labels` is present only when some item's text to show differs from the value stored. A list of related values answers empty, since it needs a record to start from. A name the file does not have answers 404 code 105; at most 5,000 values are returned.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-explain"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/explain`

Explain This Value without the assistant: the formula of a calculated field with every value it read, or the relationship a related field or portal row follows.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Formulas are the file's design and the trace reads any record, so the privilege set must be [Full Access], or be able to modify scripts and read everything, and an API token limited to reading or to some layouts is refused (403 code 9). For a table of another hosted file the same must hold in that file. The record must be one the account can view.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `recordId` | body | number | yes | The record |
| `field` | body | string | yes | The field, as "Field" or "TO::Field" (a trailing repetition like (2) is ignored) |
| `row` | body | number | no | For a portal row: the related record's id |
| `portal` | body | string | no | The portal's name, with row (default: the field's table occurrence) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/explain
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"recordId":7,"field":"Total Due"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "field": {
    "field": "Total Due",
    "formula": "Total - Paid",
    "references": [
      {
        "field": "Total",
        "value": "198"
      },
      {
        "field": "Paid",
        "value": "0"
      }
    ],
    "result": "198"
  }
}
```

A field of the layout's own table answers {"field": {…}}, the trace of its formula. A related field outside a portal answers {"related": {…}}: the record it shows, found through the relationship. A portal row answers {"related": {…}} for how the row's record relates to this one, with "field" added when the field is a calculation or summary in the portal's own table. Secrets are redacted from the values. No record or field, or a row that is not a record id: 400 code 5; a field the table does not have, or a portal not on the layout: 400 code 102; a relationship that can't be explained: 400 code 3.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-history"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/history`

A record's history: who changed what and when, from where (web client, Data API, OData, MCP, a script, ...), newest first, with the audit entry behind each change.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. The record must be one the account can view, or deleted with the whole table viewable; fields the account can't see are left out.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `recordId` | body | number | yes | The record, which may have been deleted since |
| `limit` | body | number | no | The newest N audit entries (default 200, at most 2000) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/history
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"recordId":7}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "table": "Invoices",
  "recordId": 7,
  "exists": true,
  "events": [
    {
      "at": "2026-10-13T08:14:03.000Z",
      "account": "Ann",
      "kind": "changed",
      "surface": "web",
      "seqs": [
        5531
      ],
      "changes": [
        {
          "field": "Number",
          "from": 1008,
          "to": 1009,
          "seq": 5531
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "note": "Newest first. …"
}
```

Same shape as the explain_record_history tool, plus exists and, on each event, surface, script (the script that made it), copyOf (a duplicate) and revertOf (a change that put another back), and on each change its audit entry seq. A value the audit log was told not to keep shows ‹not logged›. No record: 400 code 5.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-revert"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/revert`

Puts back what one audit entry changed: an edit's fields get their old values, a created record is deleted, a deleted record is made again. Logged as a change that says which entry it reverts.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Runs with the account's privileges, so it can put back only what the account could change by hand (edit access to the fields, delete or create access to the table; a record someone else is editing answers 301).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `recordId` | body | number | yes | The record |
| `seq` | body | number | yes | The audit entry to put back (from history; 101 when it is not a change to this record) |
| `fields` | body | array of string | no | Only these fields of an edit; all of them when absent |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/revert
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"recordId":7,"seq":5531,"fields":["Status"]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "action": "updated",
  "fields": [
    "Status"
  ],
  "skipped": []
}
```

action is updated, deleted (a creation put back) or created (a deletion put back, under its own id; 504 when that id was used again). skipped lists fields left as they are, with the reason: a value the log was told not to keep, a container, a repetition, or a field not on the layout.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-refresh"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/refresh`

Fresh display records, layout formulas, charts and found-set portal rows, without committing or changing the supplied found-set order.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Layout, record and field privileges apply, including masking.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |
| `recordId` | body | number | no | Current parent record |
| `layoutId` | body | number | no | Layout currently displayed; scopes displayed identities and portal ranges across script layout changes |
| `displayRecords` | body | array of number | no | Records displayed or cached in the browser; at most 200 are read |
| `displayPortals` | body | object | no | Parent record id to portal name to displayed child ids; object refresh reevaluates these identities without changing membership, under viewing privileges |
| `foundPortalRanges` | body | object | no | Portal name to {offset, limit} (1-based); refresh returns that page and the full count so sparse paging and scroll position are retained |
| `step` | body | string | no | Refresh Window, Refresh Portal or Refresh Object; the client projects targeted patches |
| `objectId` | body | number | no | Target layout object for a portal refresh |
| `flushJoinResults` | body | boolean | no | Evict relationship query caches across involved hosted stores before reading |
| `flushExternalData` | body | boolean | no | Retained as an empty operation: no ESS/ODBC provider exists |
| `mode` | body | string | no | browse (default) or find |
| `view` | body | string | no | form, list or table |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/refresh
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"ids":[7],"recordId":7,"displayRecords":[7],"step":"Refresh Window"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "records": [
    {
      "recordId": "7",
      "modId": "1",
      "fieldData": {
        "Total": 380
      },
      "portalData": {}
    }
  ],
  "states": {
    "7": {
      "hidden": [],
      "tooltips": {},
      "placeholders": {}
    }
  },
  "foundRows": {}
}
```

Stale summary and ExecuteSQL display stand-ins are disallowed. Valid cached results remain usable. Script refreshes use the same operation inside the authorized run and attach the snapshot to an automatic Checkpoint action; acknowledge with JSON at runs/{run}/file (optionally updated layoutId, displayPortals and foundPortalRanges) after applying the actions in order. No Continue dialog is shown.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-position"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/position`

Where a record is in the window's found set, so the window can stay on it after a sort moves it to a page not loaded yet.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Only records the account can view count.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |
| `recordId` | body | number | yes | The record to look for |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoice%20List/position
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"recordId":7,"ids":[9,7,8],"sort":[{"fieldName":"Number","sortOrder":"ascend"}]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "index": 0
}
```

index is 0-based, in `sort`'s order; -1 when the record isn't in the found set, the account can't view it, or recordId isn't a whole number.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-index"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/index`

A field's index for auto-complete: its values starting with a prefix.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Privileges apply to the values listed.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `field` | body | string | yes | Field name (error 102 when missing or unknown) |
| `prefix` | body | string | no | Values starting with this |
| `limit` | body | number | no | Default 50, 1 to 500 |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/index
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"field":"Customer","prefix":"ac","limit":5}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "values": [
    "Acme",
    "Acme West"
  ]
}
```

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-export"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/export`

Export Records: the found set's chosen fields as a file to download (CSV, tab-separated text or an Excel workbook).

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. The privilege set must allow exporting records (else 403 code 9). Only records the account can view; fields it can't see export empty, and so do masked ones (a stand-in is not a value).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |
| `fields` | body | array of string | yes | Fields to export, in order (none: 400 code 3) |
| `format` | body | string | no | csv (default), tab or xlsx |
| `fieldNames` | body | boolean | no | true: a first row of field names |
| `name` | body | string | no | File name without extension; default the layout name |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/export
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"fields":["Number","Customer"],"format":"csv","fieldNames":true,"ids":[7,9]}
```

Response `200`:

```text
(the file, with Content-Disposition: attachment; filename*=UTF-8''Invoices.csv, e.g. "Number","Customer"\r\n"1007","Globex"\r\n…)
```

Returns in a field are written as vertical tabs, as FileMaker does; tabs in tab-separated output become spaces.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-import"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/import`

Import Records: a CSV, tab-separated, Excel or FileMaker XML file the person picked, previewed, planned (columns matched to fields) or imported into the layout's table.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Only fields the account may modify are targets; rows it may not create, or that fail validation, are skipped. Matching with the assistant (plan=1&ai=1) also needs the fmmcp extended privilege, the assistant on and AI allowed for the file; otherwise columns are matched by name and `ai` says why.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `Content-Type` | header | string | yes | multipart/form-data, with the file in a part named "upload" (up to 50 MB) and, for update/replace, the found set as JSON in a part named "found" ({ids} or {query, sort}) |
| `preview` | query | string | no | 1: the target fields and the first 3 rows |
| `plan` | query | string | no | 1: the columns matched to fields with fixes, a preview and duplicates (an ImportPlan) |
| `ai` | query | string | no | 1 with plan=1: match with the assistant |
| `columns` | query | string | no | JSON plan {headerRow, columns: [{column, field, transforms}], keys}: with plan=1 a new preview, else the import itself (kept for undo-import) |
| `action` | query | string | no | add (default), update or replace (the found set) |
| `match` | query | string | no | JSON list of match fields for update (default the plan's keys) |
| `addRemaining` | query | string | no | 1: rows left over become new records (update/replace) |
| `skipDuplicates` | query | string | no | 1: leave out duplicate rows |
| `skipIssues` | query | string | no | 1: leave out rows with problems |
| `mapping` | query | string | no | Without plan/columns: JSON list, column i into mapping[i] (null: not imported) |
| `skipFirst` | query | string | no | 1 with mapping: skip the first row |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/import?columns=%7B%22headerRow%22%3Atrue%2C%22columns%22%3A%5B%7B%22column%22%3A0%2C%22field%22%3A%22Number%22%7D%2C%7B%22column%22%3A1%2C%22field%22%3A%22Customer%22%7D%2C%7B%22column%22%3A2%2C%22field%22%3A%22Amount%22%7D%5D%7D
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=x

(a part named "upload" holding invoices.csv)
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "id": "9c2e41aa",
  "foundSet": [
    121,
    122
  ],
  "imported": 2,
  "skipped": []
}
```

preview=1 answers {fields, rows, count}. plan=1 answers {layout, table, rows, headerRow, fields, columns, keys, preview, summary: {ready, withIssues, duplicatesInFile, duplicatesExisting}} (plus ai). An import with columns answers {id, foundSet, imported, skipped: [{row, why}]} plus updated, pendingApproval or undoable: false when they apply. A file that can't be read, a bad plan or no field to import into answers 400 code 3.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-undo-import"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/undo-import`

Takes back an import made with `columns`: deletes the records it added and puts back what it overwrote, leaving records changed since.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. The account's privileges apply to the deletes.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `id` | body | string | yes | The import's id |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/undo-import
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":"9c2e41aa"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "deleted": 2,
  "kept": []
}
```

`restored` is added when the import overwrote records. An unknown or already undone import answers 400 code 3.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-ai-replace"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/ai-replace`

Replace Field Contents with AI: the field gets, in each record of the found set, what the assistant writes from an instruction and that record's visible values; journaled so it can be undone.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. AI must be allowed for the file (403 code 9), the privilege set needs fmmcp (401 code 9), and the assistant must be on (503 code 3). The field must be a non-global field of the layout's own table the account may modify (400 code 102). Only fields the account can see go to the model, never password, key or token fields or containers.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `field` | body | string | yes | The field to fill |
| `instruction` | body | string | yes | What the field should hold (under 2,000 characters) |
| `preview` | body | boolean | no | true: the value for one record (recordId), nothing written |
| `recordId` | body | number | no | The record for preview (404 code 101 when it can't be viewed) |
| `ids` | body | array of number | no | A script's found set by record id, in order; when absent, `query` (and `sort`) make the found set |
| `query` | body | array of object | no | Find requests, as the Data API's _find query, when `ids` is absent |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | [{fieldName, sortOrder}] |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Clients/ai-replace
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"field":"City","instruction":"The city from the address","ids":[3,4,5]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "changed": 2,
  "left": 1,
  "skipped": [],
  "undo": {
    "id": "b71f0c2d",
    "summary": "AI replaced City in 2 records",
    "kind": "replace"
  }
}
```

preview answers {"value": text or null}. At most 500 records at a time (400 code 3). A daily AI limit answers 429, a model failure 502 and a stop (closed connection or 10-minute timeout) 504, all code 3, when nothing was written; if a limit is reached partway, what was written stays and `stopped` says why. `left` counts records the assistant gave no value for.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-runs-id-file"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}/file`

Answers a button script that is waiting: a file for Insert File, Continue/Cancel for Pause, a button for Show Custom Dialog, an order for Sort Records, what Insert from Device captured, or the device's location; returns the rest of the run.

**Permissions:** The same session that started the run (Data API session token or ohbt_ API token for this file); any other session gets 404 code 101.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `id` | path | string | yes | `waiting.run` from …/button (each ask has its own id) |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `filename` | body | string | no | Insert File: the file name |
| `data` | body | string | no | Insert File, or Device for a photo, video, sound or signature: the file as base64 (up to 50 MB; or send multipart/form-data with an "upload" part) |
| `cancel` | body | boolean | no | true: Cancel (any step) |
| `button` | body | number | no | Dialog: the button, 1 to 3 |
| `inputs` | body | array of string | no | Dialog: up to three input values |
| `sort` | body | array of object | no | Sort: [{fieldName, sortOrder}] (up to 50; [] unsorts); sortOrder is ascend, descend or the name of a value list to order by |
| `value` | body | string | no | Index: the value picked, one of waiting.values (any other value counts as Cancel, error 1) |
| `text` | body | string | no | Device: a bar code's text (up to 64 KB) |
| `latitude` | body | number | no | Location: degrees, -90 to 90 (with longitude, -180 to 180) |
| `longitude` | body | number | no | Location: degrees, -180 to 180 |
| `accuracy` | body | number | no | Location: metres |
| `altitude` | body | number | no | Location, optional: metres |
| `altitudeAccuracy` | body | number | no | Location, optional: metres |
| `at` | body | number | no | Location, optional: when the device measured it (Unix ms; never later than now) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/runs/3f9a0c1d2e4b5a6f/file
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"filename":"scan.pdf","data":"JVBERi0xLjQK…"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "script": "Attach Scan",
  "result": "",
  "error": 0,
  "layout": "Invoices",
  "foundSet": [
    7
  ],
  "recordId": 7,
  "mode": "browse",
  "actions": []
}
```

A Pause is continued by {} (or an empty body). A Device wait is answered with text (a bar code), data and filename (a photo, video, sound or signature) or cancel; a Location wait with latitude and longitude (and the optional values) or cancel: true when the person refused. A location without finite latitude and longitude in range, or a Device body with none of text, data or cancel, is 400 code 960; a bar code over 64 KB 413. The answer has the same shape as …/button, and may wait again. Only POST is answered (405 code 3). Bad bodies answer 400 code 960; a file over 50 MB 413 code 960; a run that is no longer waiting 404 code 101.

<a id="web-client-post-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-runs-stop"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/runs/stop`

Stops the scripts this session is running in the file, as Esc does in FileMaker: each halts at its next step, or at once in a timed pause.

**Permissions:** Any session of the file (Data API session token or ohbt_ API token); it reaches only the scripts that same session started.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/runs/stop
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "stopped": 1
}
```

stopped counts the runs asked to stop (0 when none is running). A script that has Allow User Abort off ignores the ask (one made after it turns it back on counts), as does one waiting on the person (a dialog, Pause, Insert File), which their Cancel through …/runs/{id}/file stops instead. The stopped run's own …/button (or …/file) request answers as usual, with a Halt Script action whose reason is "canceled by the user". Only POST is answered (405 code 3).

<a id="web-client-get-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-prefs"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/prefs`

The signed-in account's own saved finds, saved sorts and recent records in this file.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Not for an API token limited to reading or to some layouts (403 code 9): saved finds name other layouts and hold find criteria. They are the person's own: another account's cannot be read.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/prefs
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "prefs": {
    "sorts": [
      {
        "name": "By customer",
        "layout": "Invoices",
        "sort": [
          {
            "fieldName": "Customer",
            "sortOrder": "ascend"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Only what has been kept comes back: finds ({saved, recent}, each a list of {name, layout, requests}), sorts (a list of {name, layout, sort}) and recent (a list of {layout, recordId, title}). A value stored in a form the client can't use is left out, as if never kept. Any method other than GET here, or PUT without a key, is 405 code 3.

<a id="web-client-put-tabularius-app-v1-databases-database-prefs-key"></a>

### `PUT /tabularius/app/v1/databases/{database}/prefs/{key}`

Keeps one of the account's saved finds, saved sorts or recent records, replacing it; a null or missing value clears it.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) for this file, from POST /fmi/data/vLatest/databases/{database}/sessions (the web client signs in with X-Tabularius-Client: web), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) whose surfaces include fmrest. On every request the account's privilege set must still have fmrest (Data API sessions and API tokens) or fmapp/fmwebdirect (web client sessions), else 401 code 9. Not for an API token limited to reading or to some layouts (403 code 9). It changes only the signed-in account's own.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `key` | path | string | yes | finds, sorts or recent (any other key is 400 code 5) |
| `value` | body | object | no | The new value, in the form GET gives it (up to 64 KB of JSON); null or left out clears the key |

**Example:**

```http
PUT /tabularius/app/v1/databases/Invoices/prefs/sorts
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"value":[{"name":"By customer","layout":"Invoices","sort":[{"fieldName":"Customer","sortOrder":"ascend"}]}]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{}
```

A body that is not JSON, or a value not in the expected form, is 400 code 5. A body over 64 KB is refused.

<a id="live"></a>

## Live updates, locks and presence

Record locks, who is looking at which record, who is in design mode, and a Server-Sent Events stream of changes, under /tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}. Every route takes the Data API session token in a header (the stream is fetched, not opened with EventSource). A locked record can still be read; writes by any other session get error 301 everywhere. Errors answer {"error":{"code":N,"message":"…"}}: 401 code 952 for a missing or expired token, 404 code 802 for a file that isn't hosted, 405 code 3 for a method a path doesn't take, and HTTP 400 for store errors.

Source: `packages/server/src/live.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/events`](#live-get-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-events) | A Server-Sent Events stream of record changes, locks, presence and messages for the file and the hosted files its layouts use. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/clients`](#live-get-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-clients) | Who is signed in to the file. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/locks`](#live-get-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-locks) | Records being edited now, in this file and the hosted files its layouts use. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/viewers`](#live-get-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-viewers) | Who is looking at which record now. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{id}/lock`](#live-post-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-id-lock) | Takes or renews the session's lock on a record, so others can't change it while it is edited. |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{id}/lock`](#live-delete-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-id-lock) | Releases the session's lock on a record. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{id}/view`](#live-post-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-id-view) | "I'm looking at this record": shows the session as a viewer (renew while it is shown). |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{id}/view`](#live-delete-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-id-view) | Stopped looking at the record. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/design`](#live-get-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-design) | Who is in design mode, and on which layout, script or table. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/design`](#live-post-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-design) | "I'm in design mode here": records where the session is (renew while open); others get a `designer` change. |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/design`](#live-delete-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-design) | Left design mode. |

<a id="live-get-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-events"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/events`

A Server-Sent Events stream of record changes, locks, presence and messages for the file and the hosted files its layouts use.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9. Each event is checked against the privileges as it happens: changes to tables the account can't see are left out, and design events go only to accounts with [Full Access].

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/live/v1/databases/Invoices/events
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```text
retry: 3000

event: change
data: {"kind":"lock","file":"Invoices","table":"Invoices","recordId":7,"account":"Ann","self":false}

event: change
data: {"kind":"update","file":"Invoices","table":"Invoices","recordId":7,"modId":3,"account":"Ann","self":false}

: ping

event: message
data: {"text":"The server restarts at 6 pm"}

event: expired
data: {}
```

Content-Type: text/event-stream. `change` kinds: create, update, delete, truncate, lock, unlock, view, leave, and for designers design and designer (with `ids`). `self` is true for the stream's own session. A ": ping" comment every 20 seconds; `expired` (then the stream ends) when the session has timed out; `message` carries the admin console's Send Message.

<a id="live-post-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-records-id-lock"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/records/{id}/lock`

Takes or renews the session's lock on a record, so others can't change it while it is edited.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9. The account must be able to edit the record through the layout (error 200; 101 when the record is missing).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `id` | path | number | yes | Record id |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/live/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/records/7/lock
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "lock": {
    "account": "Ann",
    "expires": "2026-10-13T08:15:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

A lock lasts 60 seconds unless renewed. Held by another session: 409 code 301 "Record is in use by another user (Bob)". Signing out releases a session's locks.


Response `200`:

```json
{
  "designers": [
    {
      "account": "Ann",
      "layout": 1,
      "self": false
    },
    {
      "account": "Bob",
      "layout": null,
      "script": 3,
      "self": true
    }
  ]
}
```

`layout` is null when the designer is not on a layout; `script` or `table` names what they have open instead.

<a id="live-post-tabularius-live-v1-databases-database-design"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/design`

"I'm in design mode here": records where the session is (renew while open); others get a `designer` change.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9. [Full Access] (403 code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `layout` | body | number | no | Layout id open (0 or absent: none) |
| `script` | body | number | no | Script id open, instead of a layout |
| `table` | body | number | no | Table id open, instead of a layout |
| `selection` | body | array of number | no | Selected object ids (up to 500) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/live/v1/databases/Invoices/design
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"layout":1,"selection":[23,24]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{}
```

### `DELETE /tabularius/live/v1/databases/{database}/design`

Left design mode.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9. [Full Access] (403 code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

```http
DELETE /tabularius/live/v1/databases/Invoices/design
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

```json
{}
```

<a id="changes"></a>

## Change feed

What changed in a hosted file, for other systems to keep up with it: poll GET /tabularius/changes/v1/databases/{database} with a cursor. Sign in like the Data API, with a session token or an API token. A change carries no field data, only its kind, table, record id and modification count; read the record through the Data API. Token and file errors answer {"messages":[{"code":"952","message":"…"}]} with the HTTP status (401, 404 for a file that isn't hosted).

Source: `packages/server/src/changes.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/tabularius/changes/v1/databases/{database}`](#changes-get-tabularius-changes-v1-databases-database) | Changes after a cursor (create, update, delete, truncate), with the cursor to continue from; can long-poll. |

<a id="changes-get-tabularius-changes-v1-databases-database"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/changes/v1/databases/{database}`

Changes after a cursor (create, update, delete, truncate), with the cursor to continue from; can long-poll.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9. Only tables and records the account may view are listed.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `since` | query | string | no | A cursor (`next` from an earlier answer); absent: no changes and the cursor for now |
| `wait` | query | number | no | Seconds (up to 60) to hold the request until something changes |
| `limit` | query | number | no | At most this many changes (1 to 1000, default 1000) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/changes/v1/databases/Invoices
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "changes": [],
  "next": "5e2a91c0-43"
}
```

The last 10,000 changes per file are kept in memory. A cursor older than that, or from before a restart, answers 410 {"error": "This cursor is too old or from before a restart: read what you need again, then continue from next.", "next": cursor}. Any method but GET answers 405 {"error": "method not allowed"}.

<a id="calendar"></a>

## Calendar feeds

A layout's date or timestamp field as an iCalendar (.ics) feed that a calendar app can subscribe to, and an import that reads an .ics file into the same fields: /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/calendar.ics and …/calendar-import. A date field makes all-day events (an end date is the last day, inclusive). A timestamp field has no zone, so events are floating times (the same clock reading wherever the calendar is) unless `zone` says which zone the readings are in. Record and field privileges apply as in the Data API. Errors answer {"messages":[{"code":"N","message":"…"}]} with the HTTP status (401 for a missing or expired token, 403 code 9, 404 for a layout the account can't use or a file that isn't hosted, 400 code 960 for a parameter that isn't valid, 413 for a feed over its cap).

Source: `packages/server/src/calendar.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET, HEAD | [`/tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/calendar.ics`](#calendar-get-head-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-calendar-ics) | The records of a layout (or the ones a find matches) as an iCalendar feed, oldest start first. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/calendar-import`](#calendar-post-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-calendar-import) | Reads an .ics file into records of the layout's table, one record per event (and per occurrence of a repeating event). |
| GET | [`/tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/feeds`](#calendar-get-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-feeds) | The calendar feeds in a file: label, layout, the account each acts as, and dates. Never an address. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/feeds`](#calendar-post-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-feeds) | Makes a calendar feed for the signed-in account and answers its address once. |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/feeds/{id}`](#calendar-delete-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-feeds-id) | Ends a calendar feed: its link answers 401 from then on. |

<a id="calendar-get-head-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-calendar-ics"></a>

### `GET, HEAD /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/calendar.ics`

The records of a layout (or the ones a find matches) as an iCalendar feed, oldest start first.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9. A calendar app cannot send a header, so `?token=` also takes an API token, but only one that is read-only and scoped to this one layout (403 code 9 otherwise); a sign-in session is never accepted there. Records the account may not view are left out, and a field it may not see cannot be named. Revoke the token to end a feed link.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | no | Bearer {token}; or give `token` in the query string |
| `start` | query | string | yes | A date or timestamp field of the layout's table (400 code 958 when missing, 960 when not one) |
| `end` | query | string | no | A field of the same kind as `start`; an end before the start is left out |
| `title` | query | string | no | The event's title (default "(untitled)") |
| `description` | query | string | no | The event's description |
| `location` | query | string | no | The event's location |
| `query` | query | string | no | JSON list of find requests, as the Data API's _find query; absent: every record |
| `zone` | query | string | no | The zone timestamp readings are in: UTC or an IANA name such as Europe/London. Absent: floating times |
| `limit` | query | number | no | Events at most, 1 to 5000 (default 5000), or the server's Data API limit if that is lower |
| `token` | query | string | no | A read-only API token scoped to this layout, for a calendar app that cannot send a header |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/calendar.ics?start=Due&title=Number
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

