```text
(text/calendar: BEGIN:VCALENDAR … one VEVENT per record … END:VCALENDAR)
```

Content-Type is text/calendar; charset=utf-8, with CRLF line endings, lines folded at 75 octets and text escaped; a line break in a field cannot start a new property. Each event has a stable UID from the record and file, and SEQUENCE counts the record's changes. X-Tabularius-Events and X-Tabularius-Skipped count the events written and the records skipped for having no readable start. A found set over the cap answers 413 naming its size, never a feed missing events. The reply is private and not cached, and the server log redacts `token`. A zone's skipped hour (clocks going forward) moves forward and its repeated hour is taken as the first; those two choices are Tabularius's own.

<a id="calendar-post-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-layouts-layout-calendar-import"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{layout}/calendar-import`

Reads an .ics file into records of the layout's table, one record per event (and per occurrence of a repeating event).

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9. Not for a read-only API token, and `?token=` is not accepted here (403 code 9). The account's create and field privileges apply; a refused record means no record is made.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `layout` | path | string | yes | Layout name (URL-encoded); the privilege set must be able to use it, else error 105 |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `start` | query | string | yes | The date or timestamp field that gets the start |
| `end` | query | string | no | A field of the same kind that gets the end (an all-day end is made inclusive) |
| `title` | query | string | no | The field that gets the summary |
| `description` | query | string | no | The field that gets the description |
| `location` | query | string | no | The field that gets the location |
| `uid` | query | string | no | The field that gets the event's UID (an occurrence of a repeating event gets #1, #2 …) |
| `zone` | query | string | no | UTC or an IANA name: times written in UTC, or in another zone, are stored as the clock reading in this zone |
| `body` | body | text/calendar | yes | The .ics file (at most 8 MB, 5,000 events) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/calendar-import?start=Due&title=Description
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: text/calendar

BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//example//EN
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:one@example
DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20261030
SUMMARY:Review
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "imported": 1,
  "skipped": 0,
  "notes": []
}
```

All of it or none. Repeating events become one record per occurrence for the rules DAILY, WEEKLY (optionally on named days), MONTHLY (on the start's day of the month) and YEARLY with INTERVAL, COUNT, UNTIL and EXDATE, up to 366 occurrences each; any other rule imports its first occurrence only. The reply holds counts and reasons, none of the file's text. Times in UTC are stored as their UTC clock reading unless `zone` is given, and the notes say so.

<a id="calendar-get-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-feeds"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/feeds`

The calendar feeds in a file: label, layout, the account each acts as, and dates. Never an address.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9, with Full Access (as Manage Security needs); not a read-only or layout-scoped token, and not `?token=` (403 code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/Invoices/feeds
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "feeds": [
    {
      "id": "3fa91c0e5b21",
      "label": "Team calendar",
      "account": "Ann",
      "layout": "Invoices",
      "created": "2026-10-17T09:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

A feed is a read-only API token scoped to one layout, so it is also in the file's token list (Manage Security), where it can be revoked too.

<a id="calendar-post-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-feeds"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/feeds`

Makes a calendar feed for the signed-in account and answers its address once.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9, with Full Access (403 code 9 otherwise). The account's privilege set needs the fmrest extended privilege, or the link could never open.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `layout` | body | string | yes | The layout the feed shows (404 code 105 when missing) |
| `start` | body | string | yes | A date or timestamp field of the layout's table |
| `end` | body | string | no | A field of the same kind as start |
| `title` | body | string | no | The field that gives each event's title |
| `description` | body | string | no | The field that gives each event's description |
| `location` | body | string | no | The field that gives each event's location |
| `zone` | body | string | no | UTC or an IANA name; absent: floating times |
| `query` | body | string | no | A find as a JSON string: [{"Status":"open"}] |
| `limit` | body | number | no | Events at most, 1 to 5000 |
| `label` | body | string | no | A name for the feed in the list (60 characters) |
| `expiresDays` | body | number | no | Days until the link stops working (default: never) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/Invoices/feeds
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
Content-Type: application/json

{"layout":"Invoices","start":"Due","title":"Number","label":"Team calendar"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "id": "3fa91c0e5b21",
  "layout": "Invoices",
  "address": "/tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/calendar.ics?start=Due&title=Number&token=ohbt_…",
  "url": "https://example.test/tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/Invoices/calendar.ics?start=Due&title=Number&token=ohbt_…"
}
```

The address carries the token and is answered only here: it is not stored and is not in the list, as an API token is shown once. The fields are checked as a request for the feed would check them, so a feed that could never open is not made. Making a feed is logged in the file's security log.

<a id="calendar-delete-tabularius-calendar-v1-databases-database-feeds-id"></a>

### `DELETE /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/{database}/feeds/{id}`

Ends a calendar feed: its link answers 401 from then on.

**Permissions:** Data API session token (Authorization: Bearer, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token) or a scoped API token (ohbt_…, surfaces including fmrest) for this file. The privilege set must still have fmrest (or fmapp/fmwebdirect for a web client session), else 401 code 9, with Full Access (403 code 9 otherwise).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Bearer {token}: a Data API session token or an ohbt_ API token (X-FM-Data-Access-Token also works) |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The feed's id from the list (404 code 101 when there is no such feed; another kind of token is never touched) |

**Example:**

```http
DELETE /tabularius/calendar/v1/databases/Invoices/feeds/3fa91c0e5b21
Authorization: Bearer 2f1c…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "revoked": "3fa91c0e5b21"
}
```

Logged in the file's security log.

<a id="sql"></a>

## SQL

Read-only FileMaker SQL over a hosted file, for reports, spreadsheets and BI tools: tabularius's counterpart of ODBC/JDBC access, at /tabularius/sql/v1/databases/{database}. Tables are table occurrences, as in ExecuteSQL; only SELECT runs, on a read-only connection. Sign in with HTTP Basic, a Data API session token or an API token; the privilege set needs fmxdbc and, since SQL reads rows directly, must be able to view every record and field, so an account with a masked field is refused. Errors answer {"error":{"code":N,"message":"…"}}; a 401 carries WWW-Authenticate: Basic. A path may end with a slash.

Source: `packages/server/src/sql.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| POST | [`/tabularius/sql/v1/databases/{database}`](#sql-post-tabularius-sql-v1-databases-database) | Runs a SELECT and answers its columns and rows as JSON, or as CSV. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/sql/v1/databases/{database}`](#sql-get-tabularius-sql-v1-databases-database) | Runs a SELECT given in the query string (for spreadsheet "from web" imports). |
| GET | [`/tabularius/sql/v1/databases/{database}/tables`](#sql-get-tabularius-sql-v1-databases-database-tables) | The table occurrences SQL sees, with their stored columns. |

<a id="sql-post-tabularius-sql-v1-databases-database"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/sql/v1/databases/{database}`

Runs a SELECT and answers its columns and rows as JSON, or as CSV.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password, checked with the sign-in lockout and then remembered for a minute), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; its surfaces must include fmxdbc and it must not be limited to layouts, else 403 code 9). The privilege set needs the fmxdbc extended privilege (401 code 9). The privilege set must view every record and field of the tables the query reads (401 code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Basic …, or Bearer {session token or ohbt_ token} |
| `sql` | body | string | yes | The query (error 10 when missing) |
| `params` | body | array | no | Values for ? placeholders: strings, numbers or nulls |
| `limit` | body | number | no | Rows at most, 1 to 1,000,000 (default 10,000) |
| `format` | body | string | no | json (default) or csv; also read from the query string |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/sql/v1/databases/Invoices
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
Content-Type: application/json

{"sql":"SELECT Customer, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoices WHERE Total > ? GROUP BY Customer","params":[100],"limit":1000}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "columns": [
    {
      "name": "Customer",
      "type": "TEXT"
    },
    {
      "name": "n",
      "type": null
    }
  ],
  "rows": [
    [
      "Acme",
      4
    ],
    [
      "Globex",
      2
    ]
  ],
  "rowCount": 2,
  "truncated": false
}
```

Container values come back as base64. CSV answers text/csv with a header row, and X-Tabularius-Truncated: {limit} when rows were cut off. A query that fails (or isn't a read) answers 400, code 8310 for SQL errors; bad params, limit or format answer 400 code 960.

<a id="sql-get-tabularius-sql-v1-databases-database"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/sql/v1/databases/{database}`

Runs a SELECT given in the query string (for spreadsheet "from web" imports).

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password, checked with the sign-in lockout and then remembered for a minute), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; its surfaces must include fmxdbc and it must not be limited to layouts, else 403 code 9). The privilege set needs the fmxdbc extended privilege (401 code 9). The privilege set must view every record and field of the tables the query reads (401 code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Basic …, or Bearer {session token or ohbt_ token} |
| `q` | query | string | yes | The query (or `sql`) |
| `limit` | query | number | no | Rows at most, 1 to 1,000,000 (default 10,000) |
| `format` | query | string | no | json (default) or csv |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/sql/v1/databases/Invoices?format=csv&sql=SELECT%20Number%2C%20Customer%20FROM%20Invoices
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```text
(text/csv: Number,Customer\r\n1007,Globex\r\n…)
```

Same answers and errors as POST. Methods other than GET and POST answer 405 code 3.

<a id="sql-get-tabularius-sql-v1-databases-database-tables"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/sql/v1/databases/{database}/tables`

The table occurrences SQL sees, with their stored columns.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password, checked with the sign-in lockout and then remembered for a minute), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; its surfaces must include fmxdbc and it must not be limited to layouts, else 403 code 9). The privilege set needs the fmxdbc extended privilege (401 code 9). The privilege set must view every record and field in the file (401 code 9); occurrences of other files are listed only when it can there too.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Basic …, or Bearer {session token or ohbt_ token} |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/sql/v1/databases/Invoices/tables
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "tables": [
    {
      "name": "Invoices",
      "baseTable": "Invoices",
      "file": "Invoices",
      "columns": [
        {
          "name": "Number",
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "name": "Customer",
          "type": "text"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Unstored calculations and summary fields have no column. Only GET (405 code 3).

<a id="odata"></a>

## OData

OData v4 over hosted files at /fmi/odata/v4, like FileMaker Server's OData API, so Excel, Power BI and other OData clients connect directly. Entity sets are table occurrences; records are keyed by ROWID (the record id) and ROWMODID is the modification count; names that aren't OData identifiers have those characters replaced with "_". Sign in per file with HTTP Basic, a Data API session token or an API token; the privilege set needs fmodata, and record, field and script access apply. Responses carry OData-Version: 4.0; errors answer {"error":{"code":"…","message":"…"}} (code as text), and a 401 carries WWW-Authenticate: Basic. A read-only API token may only GET (403 code "9"). HEAD is answered on every address GET is, with GET's status and headers and no body; a method an address doesn't take answers 405 with Allow.

Source: `packages/server/src/odata.ts`, `packages/server/src/odata-batch.ts`, `packages/server/src/odata-apply.ts`, `packages/server/src/odata-search.ts`, `packages/server/src/odata-crossjoin.ts`, `packages/server/src/odata-schema.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4) | The hosted files, as entity containers, when the server lists them publicly. |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database) | The service document: the file's entity sets (table occurrences the account can see). |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/$metadata`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-metadata) | CSDL XML: an entity type per entity set, with ROWID as key, ROWMODID, the fields the account can see and a navigation property per relationship. |
| POST | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/$batch`](#odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-batch) | Several requests in one: multipart/mixed (OData 4.0) or JSON (OData 4.01), each answered as it would be on its own. A change set (a multipart/mixed part inside the batch, or JSON requests sharing an atomicityGroup) is one transaction: if any of its requests fails, none of its changes are kept. |
| POST | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/Script.{name}`](#odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-script-name) | Runs a script, with a parameter, and answers its result. |
| POST | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/FileMaker_Tables`](#odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-filemaker-tables) | Creates a table, with its fields, as FileMaker Server's OData schema changes do. Like a table made in Design mode, it gets a table occurrence (so it is an entity set straight away) and a layout. |
| POST | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/FileMaker_Indexes/{table}`](#odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-filemaker-indexes-table) | Indexes a field: {"indexName": "field"}. DELETE /FileMaker_Indexes/{table}/{field} removes its index (204). |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset) | Records of an entity set, with $filter, $search, $select, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count and $expand; pages follow @odata.nextLink. |
| POST | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}`](#odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset) | Creates a record and answers it, with Location and ETag headers. |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}/$count`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-count) | How many records the entity set (with $filter) has, as plain text. |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/$crossjoin({sets})`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-crossjoin-sets) | Pairs (or triples) of records from two or three entity sets that $filter keeps, as OData 4.0 $crossjoin has it. |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{navigation}/$count`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-navigation-count) | How many records are related to one record through a navigation property (with $filter), as plain text. |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{navigation}/$ref`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-navigation-ref) | Links to the records related to one record through a navigation property (also {navigation}({rowid})/$ref for one), without their data. |
| GET | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`](#odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id) | One record by ROWID, with its ETag. |
| PATCH | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`](#odata-patch-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id) | Changes fields of a record; If-Match guards against changes made since it was read. |
| PUT | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`](#odata-put-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id) | The same as PATCH: changes the fields given. |
| DELETE | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`](#odata-delete-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id) | Deletes a record. |
| GET, HEAD | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{property}`](#odata-get-head-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-property) | One property of a record. |
| GET, HEAD | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{property}/$value`](#odata-get-head-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-property-value) | A property's raw value as plain text; for a container, the file itself. |
| PATCH, PUT, DELETE | [`/fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{property}`](#odata-patch-put-delete-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-property) | Puts a file in a container field (the request body, with its Content-Type), or empties it (DELETE). The same works at …/{property}/$value. |

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4`

The hosted files, as entity containers, when the server lists them publicly.

**Permissions:** None: signing in happens per file. Only on a server started with --list-files-publicly; otherwise 404 code "3", and a caller names the file in the address.

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/$metadata",
  "value": [
    {
      "name": "Invoices",
      "kind": "EntityContainer",
      "url": "Invoices"
    }
  ]
}
```

Only GET (405 code "3").

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}`

The service document: the file's entity sets (table occurrences the account can see).

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Basic …, or Bearer {session token or ohbt_ token} |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata",
  "value": [
    {
      "name": "Invoices",
      "kind": "EntitySet",
      "url": "Invoices"
    },
    {
      "name": "Line_Items",
      "kind": "EntitySet",
      "url": "Line_Items"
    }
  ]
}
```

A file that isn't hosted answers 404 code "802". Only GET.

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-metadata"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/$metadata`

CSDL XML: an entity type per entity set, with ROWID as key, ROWMODID, the fields the account can see and a navigation property per relationship.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Fields the account can't see are left out, and so are masked ones (they can't be selected, filtered or ordered by: 400).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Authorization` | header | string | yes | Basic …, or Bearer {session token or ohbt_ token} |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```text
(application/xml: <edmx:Edmx Version="4.0"> … <EntityType Name="Invoices"><Key><PropertyRef Name="ROWID"/></Key><Property Name="ROWID" Type="Edm.Int64" Nullable="false"/> … <Property Name="Total" Type="Edm.Decimal" Scale="variable"/> … <EntitySet Name="Invoices" EntityType="Invoices.Invoices"/> …)
```

Field types map to Edm.String (text, container), Edm.Decimal (number), Edm.Date, Edm.TimeOfDay and Edm.DateTimeOffset. Each relationship gives the entity sets at both ends a NavigationProperty named after the other (Collection type), with a NavigationPropertyBinding on the entity set, when the account can see both tables and read every match field at both ends (a hidden or masked key would otherwise show through the related records). Only GET.

<a id="odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-batch"></a>

### `POST /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/$batch`

Several requests in one: multipart/mixed (OData 4.0) or JSON (OData 4.01), each answered as it would be on its own. A change set (a multipart/mixed part inside the batch, or JSON requests sharing an atomicityGroup) is one transaction: if any of its requests fails, none of its changes are kept.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"), once for the whole batch: every request in it has exactly that access, and a read-only API token's writes are refused (403 code "9") one by one.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `Content-Type` | header | string | yes | multipart/mixed; boundary=…, or application/json |
| `Prefer` | header | string | no | odata.continue-on-error: run the requests after one that fails (otherwise the batch stops there) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$batch
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
Content-Type: application/json

{"requests":[{"id":"1","method":"POST","url":"Invoices","atomicityGroup":"g","body":{"Customer":"Acme","Amount":75}},{"id":"2","method":"PATCH","url":"$1","atomicityGroup":"g","body":{"Amount":10}},{"id":"3","method":"GET","url":"Invoices/$count"}]}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "responses": [
    {
      "id": "1",
      "atomicityGroup": "g",
      "status": 201,
      "headers": {
        "location": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(8)",
        "etag": "W/\"0\""
      },
      "body": {
        "ROWID": 8,
        "ROWMODID": 0,
        "Customer": "Acme",
        "Amount": 75
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "2",
      "atomicityGroup": "g",
      "status": 204,
      "headers": {
        "etag": "W/\"1\""
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "3",
      "status": 200,
      "headers": {
        "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"
      },
      "body": "8"
    }
  ]
}
```

A request's URL is relative to the file's service root, an absolute path or a full URL, and must be in the same file (400 code "3" otherwise); "$1" stands for what request 1 (its Content-ID or id) created. A failed change set is answered in multipart with its one error; in JSON, the request that failed says why and the rest of its group answer 424. A JSON request whose dependsOn names a failed request or group answers 424. Container files ($value of a container field) and a $batch inside a batch are refused (400). At most 1,000 requests and 32 MB; once the answers reach 64 MB, the requests after them answer 400 without running, and a change set that passes it keeps nothing. A Script.{name} call in a change set shares its transaction (the script can't open its own), and a script that ends with an error still answers 200, so it doesn't fail the set; Content-IDs are unique and hold no control characters. A body that isn't a batch is refused whole (400); only POST (405). A batch holds at most 1000 requests (400 otherwise), and at most 5 of them may be $crossjoin (the rest answer 400, each join runs a worker for up to 10 seconds).

<a id="odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-script-name"></a>

### `POST /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/Script.{name}`

Runs a script, with a parameter, and answers its result.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). The privilege set must be able to run the script (403 code "9"); a read-only API token is refused. Scripts run offline unless the server allows network access.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `name` | path | string | yes | Script name (exact, else case-insensitive), or FMSID:{id} for its id (so renaming the script breaks nothing); 404 code "104" when missing |
| `scriptParameterValue` | body | string, number or object | no | The script parameter; objects are sent as JSON text |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Script.Mark%20Paid
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
Content-Type: application/json

{"scriptParameterValue":"1007"}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "scriptResult": {
    "code": 0,
    "resultParameter": "ok"
  }
}
```

Global variables last between calls by the same account. Only POST (405 code "3").

<a id="odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-filemaker-tables"></a>

### `POST /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/FileMaker_Tables`

Creates a table, with its fields, as FileMaker Server's OData schema changes do. Like a table made in Design mode, it gets a table occurrence (so it is an entity set straight away) and a layout.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"), and [Full Access] (403 code "9" otherwise). Logged as a design change under the account.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `tableName` | body | string | yes | The new table's name |
| `fields` | body | array | no | Fields: {name, type, nullable, primary, unique, global, repetitions, default}. type is VARCHAR or CHARACTER VARYING (an optional length becomes a maximum-characters check), NUMERIC, DECIMAL, INT, DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP, or BLOB, VARBINARY, LONGVARBINARY or BINARY VARYING (container). nullable false = not empty; primary = not empty and unique; default = USER, USERNAME, CURRENT_USER, CURRENT_DATE, CURDATE, CURRENT_TIME, CURTIME, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURTIMESTAMP or NOW (an auto-enter creation value) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/FileMaker_Tables
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
Content-Type: application/json

{"tableName":"Visits","fields":[{"name":"Code","type":"VARCHAR(10)","primary":true},{"name":"Day","type":"DATE","default":"CURRENT_DATE"}]}
```

Response `201`:

```json
{
  "tableName": "Visits",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "Code",
      "type": "text",
      "kind": "normal",
      "nullable": false,
      "unique": true
    },
    {
      "name": "Day",
      "type": "date",
      "kind": "normal"
    }
  ]
}
```

An unknown type, default or field property answers 400 with what is wrong. Schema changes can't be part of a $batch change set (400): a rolled-back set would leave the design changed. PATCH /FileMaker_Tables/{table} with {"fields":[…]} adds fields (200, the table as above); DELETE /FileMaker_Tables/{table} deletes the table and DELETE /FileMaker_Tables/{table}/{field} a field (204; 404 code "100" or "102" when missing). A deleted table or field can be restored from Design mode. FileMaker_Tables and FileMaker_Indexes are reserved, as on FileMaker Server: a table occurrence of either name is not an entity set.

<a id="odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-filemaker-indexes-table"></a>

### `POST /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/FileMaker_Indexes/{table}`

Indexes a field: {"indexName": "field"}. DELETE /FileMaker_Indexes/{table}/{field} removes its index (204).

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"), and [Full Access] (403 code "9" otherwise).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `table` | path | string | yes | The table to index a field of |
| `indexName` | body | string | yes | The field to index (case-insensitive) |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/FileMaker_Indexes/Visits
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
Content-Type: application/json

{"indexName":"Code"}
```

Response `201`:

```json
{
  "indexName": "Code"
}
```

Sets the field's value index and builds it, so finds and sorts on it stop reading every record. Unstored calculations, summaries, globals and containers can't be indexed (400 code "102").

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}`

Records of an entity set, with $filter, $search, $select, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count and $expand; pages follow @odata.nextLink.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Only records and fields the account can view.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set (or table occurrence) name; 404 code "102" when unknown |
| `$filter` | query | string | no | eq ne gt ge lt le in, and or not, add sub mul div mod, contains startswith endswith indexof concat substring length tolower toupper trim year month day hour minute second date time round floor ceiling now mindatetime maxdatetime totaloffsetminutes, cast(value, Edm.String\|Int32\|Double\|Date…); only stored fields. Related records: Orders/any(o: o/Total gt 50) and Orders/all(o: …) test the related records the account may view (all passes with none; at most 3 deep and 20 per filter; up to 20,000 related records are read, 400 past that; 400 inside $expand, $apply and $crossjoin). At most 1,000,000 characters and 10,000 names, values and operators, nested at most 32 deep (400 past any of these) |
| `$search` | query | string | no | Free text over the stored text fields the account can see: words (all must appear, in any fields), "phrases", AND, OR, NOT and parentheses. A-Z ignore case. Number, date and time fields aren't searched. At most 100 terms, nested at most 32 deep; inside a phrase only \" and \\ are escapes. Applies with $filter and on /$count; a $search that can't be read is 400 |
| `$select` | query | string | no | Comma-separated properties |
| `$orderby` | query | string | no | Property [asc\|desc], …; only stored fields (ROWID order is the default) |
| `$top` | query | number | no | Records at most |
| `$skip` | query | number | no | Records to skip ($skiptoken is read the same way) |
| `$count` | query | boolean | no | true: add @odata.count |
| `$format` | query | string | no | json only (else 501) |
| `$apply` | query | string | no | Groups and totals: filter(…) steps, then one groupby((A,B)[,aggregate(…)]) or aggregate(…); aggregates are "Property with sum\|min\|max\|average\|countdistinct as Name" or "$count as Name". Only stored fields; $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip and $count then work on the rows it gives, which have no ROWID ($select and $expand: 400; other transformations: 501). Reads at most 500,000 records (400: filter first) |
| `$expand` | query | string | no | Navigation properties to put inline, comma-separated (* for all), each optionally with ($select=…;$filter=…;$orderby=…;$top=n;$skip=n), the options separated by ;; up to 1,000 related records come for each record (with $filter or $orderby, every match is read first) |
| `Prefer` | header | string | no | odata.maxpagesize=n: page size (default 1000, at most 10,000) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices?$filter=Total%20gt%20100&$select=Customer,Total&$orderby=Total%20desc&$top=2&$count=true
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata#Invoices(ROWID,ROWMODID,Customer,Total)",
  "@odata.count": 14,
  "value": [
    {
      "@odata.etag": "W/\"3\"",
      "ROWID": 7,
      "ROWMODID": 3,
      "Customer": "Globex",
      "Total": 950
    },
    {
      "@odata.etag": "W/\"0\"",
      "ROWID": 12,
      "ROWMODID": 0,
      "Customer": "Acme",
      "Total": 420.5
    }
  ]
}
```

$compute=Expression as Name,... works out a property for each record of a list (the expressions are those of $filter, the names new ones): $select shows it and $filter can use it; $orderby on it answers 501, and it cannot be used with $apply. $levels answers 501, and so do options inside $expand other than $select, $filter, $orderby, $top and $skip; an unknown navigation property is 400 code "102"; other unknown $ options 400 code "8310". Related records follow record and field access as the records themselves do. A navigation property may be named once (400 otherwise). A page whose related records pass 20,000 ends early, with @odata.nextLink carrying on from there; a single record or navigation past that is 400. Filter and orderby errors are 400 (code "102" for an unknown or unstored property). Timestamps come back with Z.

<a id="odata-post-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset"></a>

### `POST /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}`

Creates a record and answers it, with Location and ETag headers.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). The privilege set must be able to create records; fields must be modifiable (400 code "201"). A read-only API token is refused.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `Prefer` | header | string | no | return=minimal: answer 204 with no body, the new record's address in OData-EntityId (and Location); return=representation (the default): 201 with the record. Either is echoed in Preference-Applied |
| `(properties)` | body | object | yes | Property values; ROWID, ROWMODID and other @-annotations are ignored. Calculations can't be written. A container takes its file as base64, with Field@com.filemaker.odata.ContentType and Field@com.filemaker.odata.Filename beside it (null empties it), up to 64 MB |

**Example:**

```http
POST /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
Content-Type: application/json

{"Customer":"Initech","Amount":75}
```

Response `201`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata#Invoices/$entity",
  "@odata.etag": "W/\"0\"",
  "ROWID": 121,
  "ROWMODID": 0,
  "Customer": "Initech",
  "Amount": 75
}
```

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-count"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}/$count`

How many records the entity set (with $filter) has, as plain text.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Counts only records the account can view.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `$filter` | query | string | no | As for the entity set |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices/$count
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```text
(text/plain: 120)
```

Only GET.

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-crossjoin-sets"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/$crossjoin({sets})`

Pairs (or triples) of records from two or three entity sets that $filter keeps, as OData 4.0 $crossjoin has it.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Each set is read as the account sees it: only records it can view, and only fields it can read can be named.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `sets` | path | string | yes | 2 or 3 entity set names, comma-separated, each once |
| `$filter` | query | string | no | As for an entity set, with properties named Set/Property (Set/ROWID for the record id). Conditions on one set alone narrow it before the join |
| `$orderby` | query | string | no | Set/Property [asc\|desc], comma-separated |
| `$expand` | query | string | no | Sets to put inline instead of a link, comma-separated (* for all), each optionally with ($select=…) |
| `$top` | query | number | no | At most this many rows |
| `$skip` | query | number | no | Rows to skip |
| `$count` | query | boolean | no | true: add @odata.count |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$crossjoin(Customers,Invoices)?$filter=Customers/ID eq Invoices/CustomerID&$expand=Invoices($select=Total)
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata#Collection(Edm.ComplexType)",
  "value": [
    {
      "Customers@odata.navigationLink": "Customers(1)",
      "Invoices@odata.navigationLink": "Invoices(2)"
    }
  ]
}
```

Only GET. Reads at most 100,000 records of each set (and 64 MB of the text  and  name), joins at most 500,000 combinations, and stops a join that runs past 10 s (400 past any of these: narrow each set with a condition on it alone). The join runs in a process of its own, at most 2 at once (503 past that). $select is not supported at the top level; use $expand(…;$select=…).

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-navigation-count"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{navigation}/$count`

How many records are related to one record through a navigation property (with $filter), as plain text.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Counts only related records the account can view.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `navigation` | path | string | yes | Navigation property |
| `$filter` | query | string | no | On the related records |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Customers(1)/Invoices/$count
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```text
(text/plain: 4)
```

Only GET. 404 when the record is missing or the account can't view it; a relationship with more than 20,000 related records is 400.

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-navigation-ref"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{navigation}/$ref`

Links to the records related to one record through a navigation property (also {navigation}({rowid})/$ref for one), without their data.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Lists only related records the account can view.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `navigation` | path | string | yes | Navigation property |
| `$filter` | query | string | no | On the related records |
| `$orderby` | query | string | no | On the related records |
| `$top` | query | number | no | At most this many links |
| `$skip` | query | number | no | Links to skip |
| `$count` | query | boolean | no | true: add @odata.count |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Customers(1)/Invoices/$ref?$top=2
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata#Collection($ref)",
  "value": [
    {
      "@odata.id": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)"
    },
    {
      "@odata.id": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(9)"
    }
  ]
}
```

Only GET. 404 when the record is missing, or (for one link) is not related to this one or the account can't view it. Changing relationships through $ref is not supported: related records are linked by their match fields.

<a id="odata-get-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id"></a>

### `GET /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`

One record by ROWID, with its ETag.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Record and field access apply (404 code "101" when missing or not viewable).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID, as Invoices(7) or Invoices(ROWID=7) |
| `$expand` | query | string | no | Navigation properties to put inline, as for the entity set |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata#Invoices/$entity",
  "@odata.etag": "W/\"3\"",
  "ROWID": 7,
  "ROWMODID": 3,
  "Customer": "Globex",
  "Total": 950
}
```

<a id="odata-patch-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id"></a>

### `PATCH /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`

Changes fields of a record; If-Match guards against changes made since it was read.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). The account must be able to edit the record (403) and modify the fields (400 code "201"). A read-only API token is refused.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `If-Match` | header | string | no | The ETag (W/"3") or *; a stale one answers 412 code "306" |
| `Prefer` | header | string | no | return=representation: answer 200 with the record; return=minimal (the default): 204 with no body. Either is echoed in Preference-Applied |
| `(properties)` | body | object | yes | Property values to set; a container's file as base64, as for create |

**Example:**

```http
PATCH /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
If-Match: W/"3"
Content-Type: application/json

{"Amount":975}
```

Response `204`:

```text
(empty body; ETag: W/"4")
```

A record locked by another session answers 409 code "301".

<a id="odata-put-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id"></a>

### `PUT /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`

The same as PATCH: changes the fields given.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). As PATCH. A read-only API token is refused.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `If-Match` | header | string | no | The ETag or * |
| `(properties)` | body | object | yes | Property values to set; a container's file as base64, as for create |

**Example:**

```http
PUT /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
If-Match: *
Content-Type: application/json

{"Amount":975}
```

Response `204`:

```text
(empty body; ETag: W/"4")
```

Fields left out are not cleared.

<a id="odata-delete-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id"></a>

### `DELETE /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})`

Deletes a record.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). The account must be able to delete the record. A read-only API token is refused.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `If-Match` | header | string | no | The ETag or *; a stale one answers 412 code "306" |

**Example:**

```http
DELETE /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
If-Match: W/"4"
```

Response `204`:

```text
(empty body)
```

<a id="odata-get-head-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-property"></a>

### `GET, HEAD /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{property}`

One property of a record.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Field access applies (404 code "102" for a property the account can't see).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `property` | path | string | yes | Property name, ROWID / ROWMODID, or a navigation property: its related records as a collection (with $select, $filter, $orderby, $top, $skip and $count), Nav/$count for how many (plain text, with $filter), or Nav({rowid}) for one of them |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)/Customer
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "@odata.context": "https://fms.example.com/fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/$metadata#Invoices(7)/Customer",
  "value": "Globex"
}
```

A navigation property answers {"@odata.context": …#{target set}, "value": [records]}, the records the account can view (up to 1,000; $count=true adds @odata.count of all of them). Nav({rowid}) (with $select and $expand) answers that record, with its ETag, while it is related to this one and the account can view it, else 404 code "101". Navigation goes one relationship at a time; anything after a property is 404 code "3". Other methods answer 405.

<a id="odata-get-head-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-property-value"></a>

### `GET, HEAD /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{property}/$value`

A property's raw value as plain text; for a container, the file itself.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). Field access applies.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `property` | path | string | yes | Property name |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)/Customer/$value
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```text
(text/plain: Globex)
```

An empty value (or empty container) answers 204. Containers are sent with their content type (and range support when the server serves container files).

<a id="odata-patch-put-delete-fmi-odata-v4-database-entityset-id-property"></a>

### `PATCH, PUT, DELETE /fmi/odata/v4/{database}/{entitySet}({id})/{property}`

Puts a file in a container field (the request body, with its Content-Type), or empties it (DELETE). The same works at …/{property}/$value.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or a scoped API token (Bearer ohbt_…; surfaces must include fmodata, and a layout-limited token is refused with 403). The privilege set needs the fmodata extended privilege (401 code "9"). The field must be modifiable for the account (405 "cannot be modified" otherwise) and the record editable; a read-only API token is refused (403 code "9").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | Hosted file name |
| `entitySet` | path | string | yes | Entity set name |
| `id` | path | number | yes | ROWID |
| `property` | path | string | yes | A container field |
| `Content-Type` | header | string | no | The file's type (application/octet-stream when absent) |
| `Content-Disposition` | header | string | no | attachment; filename="…" names the file (folders are dropped) |
| `If-Match` | header | string | no | The record's ETag: refused with 412 code "306" when it changed |

**Example:**

```http
PATCH /fmi/odata/v4/Invoices/Invoices(7)/Scan
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
Content-Type: application/pdf
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="invoice.pdf"

(the file)
```

Response `204`:

```text
(no body; ETag: W/"4")
```

Files over 64 MB answer 413; the Data API's container upload streams bigger ones. An empty body is 400. Other fields answer 405: they are changed by PATCH on the record.

<a id="cwp-xml"></a>

## Custom Web Publishing XML (reads)

The legacy XML interface of FileMaker Server at /fmi/xml, for scripts and pages written against it, reads only. The grammar is the document name: fmresultset.xml, FMPXMLRESULT.xml, or FMPXMLLAYOUT.xml (for -view). The command and its parameters are in the query string (or a POST form): -dbnames, -layoutnames (-db), -scriptnames (-db), -find, -findall, -findany, -findquery and -view (-db and -lay), with -skip, -max (default all records found, up to the server's per-request limit), -sortfield.N and -sortorder.N, -lop (and or or), -recid, -lay.response, field=value with field.op (eq, cn, bw (the default), ew, gt, gte, lt, lte, neq), and -query with -qN and -qN.value for -findquery. -new, -edit, -delete and -dup are refused with error 3 and any -script parameter with 960, so nothing here changes a record or runs a script. Sign in on every request with HTTP Basic; the privilege set needs the fmxml extended privilege. Errors are an error code in the document asked for, with HTTP 200; only a missing or wrong sign-in is a 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic.

Source: `packages/server/src/cwp-xml.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET, HEAD, POST | [`/fmi/xml/{grammar}.xml`](#cwp-xml-get-head-post-fmi-xml-grammar-xml) | Finds records (or lists databases, layouts and scripts, or describes a layout) and answers them as XML in the grammar named. |

<a id="cwp-xml-get-head-post-fmi-xml-grammar-xml"></a>

### `GET, HEAD, POST /fmi/xml/{grammar}.xml`

Finds records (or lists databases, layouts and scripts, or describes a layout) and answers them as XML in the grammar named.

**Permissions:** HTTP Basic (account name and password), a Data API session token (Bearer or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), or an API token that is not limited to particular surfaces or layouts (Bearer ohbt_…; a token scoped to surfaces cannot name fmxml, so it is refused with 403 code 9). The privilege set needs the fmxml extended privilege (error 9), and record, field, layout and script access apply: fields the account can't see are left out of the metadata and the records, and layouts and scripts it can't use are not listed (-layoutnames, -scriptnames) or opened (105). -dbnames needs no sign-in, and lists files only on a server started with --list-files-publicly (error 3 otherwise).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `grammar` | path | string | yes | fmresultset, FMPXMLRESULT or FMPXMLLAYOUT; another .xml name is error 954. FMPXMLLAYOUT answers -view only. |
| `-db` | query | string | no | The hosted file (955 when missing; 802 when it is not hosted). Not used by -dbnames. |
| `-lay` | query | string | no | The layout, for -find, -findall, -findany, -findquery and -view (105 when missing or not usable) |
| `-find, -findall, -findany, -findquery, -view, -dbnames, -layoutnames, -scriptnames` | query | flag | yes | The query command: exactly one (4 when none, 957 when more than one) |
| `-skip, -max` | query | number | no | Records to skip, and at most how many to return (a number or all) |
| `-sortfield.N, -sortorder.N` | query | string | no | N from 1 to 9; the order is ascend (the default), descend, or the name of a value list for a custom order |
| `field, field.op, -lop` | query | string | no | Criteria for -find: the field name = the value, with field.op = eq, cn, bw, ew, gt, gte, lt, lte or neq, joined by -lop (and, the default, or or). Values are find criteria as in the Data API, so "*", "..." and the comparison operators work in them. neq can't be used with -lop=or (960). |
| `-query, -qN, -qN.value` | query | string | no | For -findquery: -query=(q1,q2);(q3);!(q4), where a comma is and, a semicolon is or, and a leading ! omits; each qN is a field (-q1=City) and its value (-q1.value=Oslo) |
| `-recid` | query | number | no | With -find: the record with this record id (101 when there is none) |
| `-lay.response` | query | string | no | Write the records with this layout instead (it must show the same table) |

**Example:**

```http
GET /fmi/xml/fmresultset.xml?-db=Sales&-lay=Contacts&City=Oslo&City.op=eq&-max=1
Authorization: Basic QW5uOnB3
```

Response `200`:

```text
(text/xml: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
<fmresultset xmlns="http://www.filemaker.com/xml/fmresultset" version="1.0"><error code="0"/><product build="" name="tabularius" version="0.1.0"/><datasource database="Sales" date-format="MM/dd/yyyy" layout="Contacts" table="Contacts" time-format="HH:mm:ss" timestamp-format="MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss" total-count="4"/><metadata><field-definition auto-enter="no" four-digit-year="no" global="no" max-repeat="1" name="Name" not-empty="no" numeric-only="no" result="text" time-of-day="no" type="normal"/> … </metadata><resultset count="2" fetch-size="1"><record mod-id="0" record-id="3"><field name="Name"><data>Cy</data></field> … </record></resultset></fmresultset>)
```

count is the records found and fetch-size the records returned. Dates are MM/dd/yyyy, times HH:mm:ss and timestamps MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss. A repeating field has a data element for each repetition; a portal is a relatedset with a record for each row. No records found is error 401; FMPXMLRESULT has the same records as ROW/COL/DATA, with each portal field as a column with a DATA for each row. FMPXMLLAYOUT lists the layout's fields in the order it places them, how each is shown (STYLE TYPE), and the value lists they use. This interface does not run scripts, write records or serve container data.

<a id="design"></a>

## Design mode

Reads a file's whole design and changes it, at /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}: tables, fields, occurrences, relationships, value lists, custom functions, layouts, scripts and themes, plus the tools design mode uses (formula checks, layout Check and Fix, restyling, clipboard XML, where-used, the Database Design Report, the layout speed-up check and the component library shared by every file on the server). It signs in with the Data API's session tokens and needs [Full Access] on the file, as FileMaker's Manage Database does. Replies are plain JSON (no Data API envelope), sent with Cache-Control: no-store. Errors come back as {"error": {"code", "message"}} with an HTTP status: a missing, expired or other file's token is 401 with code 952 (a session token sent for another file also ends that session), an account without [Full Access] is 403 with code 9, a file that is no longer open is 404 with code 802, a method a path does not answer is 405 with code 3 ("Command is unavailable"), a body that isn't JSON is 400 with code 960, and an error from the file itself (a bad change, a missing name) is 400 with its FileMaker error code.

Source: `packages/server/src/design.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database) | The file's whole design: tables with fields and record counts, occurrences, relationships, data sources, value lists, custom functions, menus, layouts, scripts and themes. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database) | Applies a list of design changes, all or none, and returns them as applied with the new design; with ?preview=1 it describes them instead and saves nothing. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/history`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-history) | The latest 200 design changes made in Tabularius, oldest first, with who made them and when. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/ddr`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-ddr) | The Database Design Report as XML, in FileMaker's FMPReport format, as a download. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/docs`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-docs) | Documentation of the solution (tables, relationships, layouts, scripts and more) as Markdown, or as an HTML page with ?format=html, as a download. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/docs`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-docs) | The same documentation, with an introduction of your own put first. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/report`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-report) | The conversion report: what in the file won't work yet, or works differently, with a Markdown summary. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/audit`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-audit) | Record changes from the audit log: who created, changed or deleted which record and when, with the values. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/check`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-check) | Checks a formula without running it and returns its first error, as the Specify Calculation dialog reports it. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/preview`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-preview) | A formula's results on the record the person was on and the first few others, for live preview while it is typed; nothing is stored. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/restyle`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-restyle) | Puts every layout (or the ones named) onto one theme, an existing one or a new one made from colour tokens, and returns each layout before and after and the changes that do it; nothing is saved. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/modernize`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-modernize) | Makes a list, a record form and a list with the form beside it (modern layouts, HTML, CSS and JavaScript), and a classic list and form, for each table from templates with no AI, beside the file's own layouts, which are never changed; returns the layouts, the tables skipped and the changes that make them. Nothing is saved. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/snippet`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-snippet) | Turns FileMaker's clipboard XML (tables, fields, scripts, steps, custom functions, value lists) into the changes that paste it into this file, with a summary and notes; layout objects come back as objects for the layout editor to place. Nothing is applied. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/snippet/copy`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-snippet-copy) | FileMaker's clipboard XML for the tables, fields, scripts, steps, custom functions or value lists named by id; or, with objects, Layout mode's clipboard XML for layout objects. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/evaluate`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-evaluate) | A formula's result on no record, from a layout of the file (to try a custom function). |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/deleted`](#design-delete-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-deleted) | Lets go, for good, of the data kept for every deleted table and field, and returns how many went with the new design. |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/deleted/{id}`](#design-delete-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-deleted-id) | Lets go, for good, of one deleted table's or field's kept data. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/images`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-images) | The file's image library (button icons, pictures), each with a signed URL to load it from. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/images`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-images) | Adds a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or SVG image to the library. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/suggest-rules`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-suggest-rules) | Validations, value lists, serial numbers and defaults the data already follows, suggested as field options. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/impact`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-impact) | What renaming or deleting a field, table, layout, script or value list would break, here, in the other hosted files and in clients seen in the logs, before it is done. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/pending`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-pending) | Design changes staged for review, each described: what it does, a calculation, custom function or script before and after, what a rename or delete would break, who staged it, whether it would apply, and changes others made to the same thing since. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/pending`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-pending) | Stages design changes for review without making them. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/pending/apply`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-pending-apply) | Applies staged changes, all or the ones named, in the order they were staged. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/pending/discard`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-pending-discard) | Drops staged changes without applying them. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/lint`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-lint) | The script editor's Check: loops that never end and guards that catch nothing, each with a fix, on a saved script or on script text. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/used`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-used) | Where a field, table, occurrence, script, layout, custom function or value list is used. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/import-tables`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-import-tables) | Reads the files another tool exported (CSV, Excel, Notion Markdown pages) and plans or makes whole tables from them: the web client's Import Tables dialog and `tabularius import-tables`. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/graph`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-graph) | The relationship graph in plain English, its problems, and the updateOccurrence changes that tidy it (anchor-buoy aware). |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id) | A layout's design as stored, for the layout editor; single-step buttons get their step as a script line. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}/lint`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id-lint) | Check layout: what will look or behave wrong on the saved layout. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}/lint`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id-lint) | Check layout on an unsaved design: what the editor has open, laid over the saved layout. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}/fix`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id-fix) | Fix: Check's mechanical findings mended on the layout (all of them, or the ones named), with any field changes they need and what is left; nothing is saved. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}/history`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id-history) | Every save of one layout (its createLayout and updateLayout changes), oldest first, however long ago. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}/speed`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id-speed) | Make this layout faster: Check's speed findings on the saved layout, each with a redesign where there is a mechanical one, as changes to look over, and the cost before and after; nothing is saved. |
| GET, POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}/phone`](#design-get-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id-phone) | What a phone layout made from this layout (or from the design sent with POST) would show, and the phone layout already made from it, if any. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/library`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-library) | The component library: layout components saved by any file on this server, with this file's copy of each, if it has one. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/library`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-library) | Saves one of this file's components to the library: as a new entry, or as the next version when it is already a copy of one. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/library/{id}`](#design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-library-id) | Places a library component in this file, or brings this file's copy of it up to the latest version; with preview: true, shows what that would change without doing it. |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/library/{id}`](#design-delete-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-library-id) | Takes a component out of the library. Files that placed it keep their own copies. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/themes/{id}`](#design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-themes-id) | A theme in full: its element defaults and every named style, with their rules. |

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}`

The file's whole design: tables with fields and record counts, occurrences, relationships, data sources, value lists, custom functions, menus, layouts, scripts and themes.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

menuCommands and scriptSteps are shortened here; the server sends every menu command it knows by name and every script step name. A data source whose file reference finds another hosted file names it in hosted, and lists that file's tables when this account has [Full Access] there too. Layouts made for phones carry phone: {of, following}. Each theme also carries tokens (accent, accentText, text, muted, background, panel, line, and the font, text size and corner radius the theme sets, read from its button, field, label and layout defaults) and unmapped, the tokens the theme does not set, for which Tabularius's own is used.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}`

Applies a list of design changes, all or none, and returns them as applied with the new design; with ?preview=1 it describes them instead and saves nothing.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `preview` | query | string | no | 1: describe the changes (lines, and each layout they touch before and after with its Check issues) without applying them. |
| `changes` | body | array of object | yes | Design changes, each {"op": …}: createTable, createField, updateLayout, createScript, deleteField, restoreDeleted and the rest of the store's DesignOp list. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "changes": [
    {
      "op": "createField",
      "table": "Items",
      "name": "Qty",
      "type": "number"
    }
  ]
}
```

Without a changes list: 400, code 960. A change that fails rolls the whole list back and is 400 with its code (106 for a table that isn't there). undo is included when the changes can be undone (the changes that reverse them). The changes are logged under the signed-in account (see /history). With ?preview=1 the reply is {"lines": [...], "layouts": [{"id", "name", "design", "before", "issues"}]}. menuCommands and scriptSteps are shortened here; the server sends every menu command it knows by name and every script step name.

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-history"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/history`

The latest 200 design changes made in Tabularius, oldest first, with who made them and when.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/history
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "history": [
    {
```
