### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/ddr`

The Database Design Report as XML, in FileMaker's FMPReport format, as a download.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/ddr
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```text
(an XML file, Content-Type application/xml, sent as an attachment named Invoices_ddr.xml: <?xml version="1.0"?><FMPReport … type="Report" version="tabularius"><File name="Invoices.fmp12" …>…)
```

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-docs"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/docs`

Documentation of the solution (tables, relationships, layouts, scripts and more) as Markdown, or as an HTML page with ?format=html, as a download.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `format` | query | string | no | html for an HTML page; anything else (or none) for Markdown. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/docs
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```text
(a Markdown file, Content-Type text/markdown, sent as an attachment named Invoices_docs.md: "# Invoices\n\nCreated with FileMaker Tabularius. 1 tables, …")
```

The HTML page is sent with a Content-Security-Policy that lets nothing in it run (default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline').

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-docs"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/docs`

The same documentation, with an introduction of your own put first.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `format` | query | string | no | html for an HTML page; otherwise Markdown. |
| `introduction` | body | string | no | Text to put first (cut to 100,000 characters). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/docs?format=html
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "introduction": "How the invoicing file is put together."
}
```

Response `200`:

```text
(an HTML page, Content-Type text/html, sent as an attachment named Invoices_docs.html, titled "Invoices: documentation")
```

```json
            "fmapp",
            "fmwebdirect",
            "fmrest"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "coarsened": true
    }
  }
}
```

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-audit"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/audit`

Record changes from the audit log: who created, changed or deleted which record and when, with the values.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `table` | query | string | no | Only this table (any case). |
| `recordId` | query | number | no | Only this record. |
| `account` | query | string | no | Only changes by this account (any case). |
| `since` | query | string | no | Only entries at or after this ISO time. |
| `limit` | query | number | no | How many of the latest entries (default 200, at most 10,000). |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/audit?table=Items&limit=2
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "audit": [
    {
      "seq": 5,
      "at": "2026-10-13T00:09:08.341Z",
      "account": "Admin",
      "kind": "create",
      "table": "Items",
      "recordId": 2,
      "changes": {
        "Name": "Desk",
        "Price": 10,
        "Status": "open"
      }
    },
    {
      "seq": 6,
      "at": "2026-10-13T00:09:08.342Z",
      "account": "Admin",
      "kind": "update",
      "table": "Items",
      "recordId": 2,
      "changes": {
        "Status": [
          "open",
          "done"
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The latest entries, oldest first. changes holds the values set for a create, [old, new] per field for an update, and the record as it was for a delete. Security events in the log come back with security: true, and target and from when known; entries made by an AI agent account have agent: true.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-check"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/check`

Checks a formula without running it and returns its first error, as the Specify Calculation dialog reports it.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `formula` | body | string | yes | The formula. |
| `occurrence` | body | string or number | no | The table occurrence it is evaluated from, by name or id. |
| `table` | body | string or number | no | A base table, by name or id, when no occurrence is given (its first occurrence). |
| `customFunction` | body | string or number | no | A custom function whose parameters the formula may use. |
| `parameters` | body | array of string | no | Parameter names the formula may use (instead of a custom function's). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/check
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "formula": "Price * ",
  "table": "Items"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "code": 1202,
  "message": "The calculation ends too soon"
}
```

A good formula gives {"ok": true}. A failing one gives ok: false with the FileMaker error code and message, and at (the 0-based offset) when known. No formula: 400, code 960. An occurrence, table or custom function that isn't in the file: 400, code 100.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-preview"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/preview`

A formula's results on the record the person was on and the first few others, for live preview while it is typed; nothing is stored.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `formula` | body | string | yes | The formula. |
| `occurrence` | body | string or number | no | The table occurrence it runs from, by name or id. |
| `table` | body | string or number | no | A base table, when no occurrence is given. |
| `layout` | body | string | no | The layout the person is on, used first when it shows that occurrence. |
| `recordId` | body | number | no | The record the person is on, shown first. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/preview
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "formula": "Price * 2",
  "table": "Items"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "layout": "Items",
  "results": [
    {
      "recordId": 1,
      "value": "20"
    },
    {
      "recordId": 2,
      "value": "20"
    },
    {
      "recordId": 3,
      "value": "20"
    }
  ]
}
```

Up to 5 records; a record whose result is an error has error instead of value. A formula that doesn't check gives ok: false, its message, and results: []; so does one with no layout on its occurrence (ok: true, results: []).

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-restyle"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/restyle`

Puts every layout (or the ones named) onto one theme, an existing one or a new one made from colour tokens, and returns each layout before and after and the changes that do it; nothing is saved.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `theme` | body | string or number | no | An existing theme to restyle onto. |
| `tokens` | body | object | no | Colours for a new theme instead, e.g. {"accent": "#224488"}. |
| `name` | body | string | no | The new theme's name, with tokens. |
| `consistent` | body | boolean | no | Also make the layouts' local styling consistent. |
| `layouts` | body | array of number | no | Only these layouts, by id. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/restyle
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tokens": {

}
```

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-modernize"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/modernize`

Makes a list, a record form and a list with the form beside it (modern layouts, HTML, CSS and JavaScript), and a classic list and form, for each table from templates with no AI, beside the file's own layouts, which are never changed; returns the layouts, the tables skipped and the changes that make them. Nothing is saved.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `tables` | body | array of string | no | Only these tables (default: every table that has a use for them; join tables of only keys get none). |
| `styles` | body | array of string | no | Any of modern-list, modern-detail, modern-split, classic-list, classic-form (default: all). |
| `folder` | body | boolean | no | Keep the new layouts together in a "Modernized interfaces" folder of the Layouts list (default true). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/modernize
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tables": [
    "Items"
  ],
  "styles": [
    "modern-list"
  ]
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "layouts": [
    {
      "name": "Items - Modern list",
      "table": "Items",
      "style": "modern-list",
      "notes": [
        "Columns: Name, Price."
      ]
    }
  ],
  "skipped": [],
  "changes": [
    {
      "op": "createLayout",
      "name": "Items - Modern list",
      "occurrence": 1,
      "design": {
        "width": 1000,
        "parts": [
          {
            "kind": "header",
            "kindId": 1,
            "top": 0,
            "height": 60,
            "style": {}
          },
          {
            "kind": "body",
            "kindId": 4,
            "top": 60,
            "height": 150,
            "style": {}
          },
          {
            "kind": "footer",
            "kindId": 7,
            "top": 210,
            "height": 40,
            "style": {}
          }
        ],
        "objects": [
          {
            "style": {}
          }
        ]

            }

    }
  ]
}
```

Layout designs are shortened here. Apply the changes with POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}, which returns undo. A layout that is already there is skipped, so asking again only adds what is missing. A table or style that isn't there is 400, code 960.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-snippet"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/snippet`

Turns FileMaker's clipboard XML (tables, fields, scripts, steps, custom functions, value lists) into the changes that paste it into this file, with a summary and notes; layout objects come back as objects for the layout editor to place. Nothing is applied.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `xml` | body | string | yes | The clipboard XML (<fmxmlsnippet …>). |
| `table` | body | string or number | no | The table pasted fields go into. |
| `script` | body | string or number | no | The script pasted steps go into. |
| `at` | body | number | no | The step position they go in at. |
| `layout` | body | number | no | For layout objects: the layout they go onto (its theme and style names are used). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/snippet
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "table": "Items",
  "xml": "<fmxmlsnippet type=\"FMObjectList\"><Field id=\"1\" dataType=\"Number\" fieldType=\"Normal\" name=\"Stock\"><Comment/></Field></fmxmlsnippet>"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "changes": [
    {
      "op": "createField",
      "table": 129,
      "name": "Stock",
      "type": "number",
      "kind": "normal"
    }
  ],
  "summary": [
    "1 field"
  ],
  "notes": []
}
```

Layout objects (type="LayoutObjectList") come back as {"objects", "summary", "notes"}. No xml: 400, code 960; XML that isn't a snippet is 400 too.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-snippet-copy"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/snippet/copy`

FileMaker's clipboard XML for the tables, fields, scripts, steps, custom functions or value lists named by id; or, with objects, Layout mode's clipboard XML for layout objects.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `tables` | body | array of number | no | Table ids. |
| `fields` | body | object | no | {"table": id, "ids": [field ids]}. |
| `scripts` | body | array of number | no | Script ids. |
| `steps` | body | object | no | {"script": id, "indexes": [step positions]}. |
| `customFunctions` | body | array of number | no | Custom function ids. |
| `valueLists` | body | array of number | no | Value list ids. |
| `objects` | body | array of object | no | Layout objects (each with kind and bounds) instead of the above. |
| `layout` | body | number | no | With objects: the layout they come from (for its theme). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/snippet/copy
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "scripts": [
    1
  ]
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "xml": "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<fmxmlsnippet type=\"FMObjectList\"><Script includeInMenu=\"True\" runFullAccess=\"False\" id=\"1\" name=\"Finish\"><Step enable=\"True\" id=\"76\" name=\"Set Field\"><Calculation><![CDATA[\"done\"]]></Calculation><Field table=\"Items\" id=\"3\" name=\"Status\"/></Step><Step enable=\"True\" id=\"103\" name=\"Exit Script\"><Calculation><![CDATA[\"ok\"]]></Calculation></Step></Script></fmxmlsnippet>",
  "notes": []
}
```

objects that aren't a list of layout objects: 400, code 960. A pick that isn't a list of ids (e.g. "tables": "all") is 400.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-evaluate"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/evaluate`

A formula's result on no record, from a layout of the file (to try a custom function).

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `formula` | body | string | yes | The formula. |
| `layout` | body | string | no | The layout it runs from; by default the first layout whose occurrence works. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/evaluate
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "formula": "1 + 2"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "value": "3",
  "type": "number"
}
```

No formula: 400, code 960. A file with no layout to run it from: 400, code 105. A formula that fails is 400 with its error code.

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/impact`

What renaming or deleting a field, table, layout, script or value list would break, here, in the other hosted files and in clients seen in the logs, before it is done.

```json
{

    }
```

Any other kind: 400, code 5 ("kind must be field, table, layout, script or valueList"). A name that isn't there: 404, code 5.

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-pending"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/pending`

Design changes staged for review, each described: what it does, a calculation, custom function or script before and after, what a rename or delete would break, who staged it, whether it would apply, and changes others made to the same thing since.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/pending
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "changes": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "op": {
        "op": "updateField",
        "table": "Items",
        "field": "Total",
        "calculation": "Qty * Price * 1.2"
      },
      "by": "Sam",
      "at": "2026-10-18T14:50:00.000Z",
      "title": "Change field Items::Total",
      "object": {
        "kind": "field",
        "label": "field",
        "name": "Items::Total"
      },
      "lines": [],
      "diffs": [
        {
          "label": "Calculation",
          "before": "Qty * Price",
          "after": "Qty * Price * 1.2"
        }
      ],
      "status": "ready",
      "conflicts": []
    }
  ],
  "seq": 12
}
```

Each change is checked in order against the ones before it. `status` is "ready" or "blocked" (`message` says why); `conflicts` lists changes in the design history after the change was staged that touch the same thing or its table. The staged list is kept in memory and a restart clears it.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-pending"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/pending`

Stages design changes for review without making them.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `changes` | body | array | yes | Design changes (the same objects POST on the design resource takes). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/pending
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "changes": [
    {
      "op": "updateField",
      "table": "Items",
      "field": "Total",
      "calculation": "Qty * Price * 1.2"
    }
  ]
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "staged": [
    1
  ],
  "changes": [],
  "seq": 12
}
```

The response is the review, as GET gives it, with the ids of what was staged. No list, an empty list or an entry that is not an object with an "op": 400, code 960. More than 100 waiting: 400, code 960.

| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `text` | body | string | no | Script text, one step per line. |
| `script` | body | number | no | A saved script's id (checked as saved when no text is sent). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/lint
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "text": "Loop\nEnd Loop"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "issues": [
    {
      "rule": "loop-no-exit",
      "severity": "error",
      "step": 0,
      "line": 1,
      "message": "Nothing in this loop ends it: no Exit Loop If, no “Exit after last”, no Exit Script. It runs until someone stops it.",
      "fix": "Add Exit Loop If [ … ] with the condition that should end the loop.",
      "detail": "Only Exit Loop If, Go to Record or Go to Portal Row with “Exit after last”, Exit Script and Halt Script leave a loop, and this loop has none of them that runs.",
      "stepName": "Loop"
    }
  ]
}
```

Neither text nor the id of a saved script: 400, code 960.

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-used"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/used`

Where a field, table, occurrence, script, layout, custom function or value list is used.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `name` | query | string | yes | Its name (Table::Field for a field). |
| `kind` | query | string | no | field, table, tableOccurrence, script, layout, customFunction or valueList; without it every kind with that name. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/used?name=Items::Price&kind=field
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "used": [
    {
      "target": {
        "kind": "field",
        "name": "Items::Price"
      },
      "count": 1,
      "usages": [
        {
          "kind": "layout",
          "where": "Layout \"Items\"",
          "text": "field Items::Price"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-import-tables"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/import-tables`

Reads the files another tool exported (CSV, Excel, Notion Markdown pages) and plans or makes whole tables from them: the web client's Import Tables dialog and `tabularius import-tables`.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `stage` | query | string | no | "preview" (the default) answers the plan with a few rows of each sheet and writes nothing; "import" makes the tables. |
| `links` | query | string | no | 0 keeps linked-record columns as plain columns instead of making relationships. |
| `file` | body | file | yes | multipart/form-data parts named "file", one for each CSV, tab-separated text or Excel file (an Excel workbook makes a table for each sheet); at most 20. |
| `pages` | body | file | no | Parts named "pages": the .md pages of a Notion export, which make one table; other files are ignored. |
| `folder` | body | string | no | A part naming the table the pages make (the folder's name). |
| `overrides` | body | string | no | A part holding JSON {"Sheet": {"Column": "kind"}}: text, number, date, time, timestamp, checkbox, select, multi, skip, or link:<Sheet>. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/import-tables?stage=import
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=X

--X
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="Clients-Grid view.csv"
Content-Type: text/csv

Name,Notes
Acme,first

--X--
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "report": {
    "tables": 1,
    "fields": 3,
    "rows": 1,
    "joinTables": 0,
    "links": 0,
    "valueLists": 0,
    "portals": 0
  },
  "summary": [
    "1 table, 3 fields, 1 row, 0 value lists, 0 join tables holding 0 links, 0 portals"
  ]
}
```

Counts and the plan only: no record value comes back except the first three rows of each sheet in a preview, cut to 80 characters each. A preview and an import both send the files, so nothing is kept between them. Refused with 403 (code 9) for a token that is read-only or limited to layouts; 400 (code 3) for a file that cannot be read, none chosen, more than 20 files or a bad column choice; 413 over 50 MB.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-layouts-id-speed"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/layouts/{id}/speed`

Make this layout faster: Check's speed findings on the saved layout, each with a redesign where there is a mechanical one, as changes to look over, and the cost before and after; nothing is saved.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need"). With ai: true the account's privilege set also needs the fmmcp extended privilege (AI access) and AI must not be turned off for the file.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The layout's id. |
| `ai` | body | boolean | no | true: the AI assistant also proposes redesigns for the findings that have no mechanical one, from the layout's design (never its records). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/layouts/1/speed
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "layout": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Items"
  },
  "before": 24000,
  "moves": [
    {
      "kind": "unstored calculation",
      "objectIds": [
        3
      ],
      "title": "Store the calculation so it is worked out once, not on every draw",
      "changes": [
        {
          "op": "updateField",
          "table": 129,
          "field": 3,
          "storage": "stored"
        }
      ],
      "after": 40
    }
  ],
  "left": []
}
```

before and each move's after are estimated record reads to draw the layout once; moves are the redesigns (their changes can be sent to POST on the design path, which returns the undo), and left the findings with no redesign. A move the assistant proposed has ai: true and details, each change in plain words; ideas that do not apply to this file are named in ai.dropped. With ai: true the reply adds ai: {"ideas": number}, or ai: {"note"} saying why there were none (AI off for the file or the account, no fmmcp, the assistant not running on this server, or the model call failing). GET is 405.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The layout's id. |
| `design` | body | object | no | POST: the design as open, laid over the saved one. |

```http
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{}
```

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-library"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/library`

The component library: layout components saved by any file on this server, with this file's copy of each, if it has one.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need"). Anyone with [Full Access] to a file on this server can see the whole library.

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/library
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "library": [
    {
      "id": "a1b2c3d4e5f6",
      "name": "Page header",
      "width": 800,
      "height": 60,
      "objects": [],
      "version": 2,
      "updated": "2026-10-13T00:12:00.000Z",
      "from": "Invoices",
      "owner": "Invoices",
      "uses": [
        "Invoices",
        "Contacts"
      ],
      "here": {
        "component": 3,
        "version": 2
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

objects are shortened here, and carry no pictures (those stay with the file that saved them until the component is placed). here is left out when this file has no copy. Each file keeps its own copy of a component, linked to the library by id and version; a newer version is offered, not pushed.

<a id="design-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-library"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/library`

Saves one of this file's components to the library: as a new entry, or as the next version when it is already a copy of one.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need"). Only the file a component was first saved from may save new versions of it (else 403, code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `component` | body | number | yes | The id of one of this file's components. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/library
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{

}
```

A library or component over its limits (500 components, 2,000 objects in one, 8 MB of pictures in one): 400, code 960.

<a id="design-delete-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-library-id"></a>

### `DELETE /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/library/{id}`

Takes a component out of the library. Files that placed it keep their own copies.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need"). Only the file the component was first saved from may take it out (else 403, code 9).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The library entry's id (12 hex digits). |

**Example:**

```http
DELETE /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/library/a1b2c3d4e5f6
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "removed": "a1b2c3d4e5f6"
}
```

An id not in the library: 404, code 960.

<a id="design-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-themes-id"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/themes/{id}`

A theme in full: its element defaults and every named style, with their rules.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The theme's id. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/themes/1
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "theme": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "House",
    "defaults": {},
    "styles": [
      {
        "name": "Big",
        "element": 70,
        "rules": [
          {
            "part": 1,
            "state": 1,
            "css": {
              "font-size": "18pt"
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

A theme that isn't there: 404, code 960 ("Theme … is missing").

<a id="design-scripts"></a>

## Design mode: script tests, history, profile and dry run

The script editor's tools, under /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}: saved test cases, each save of a script, step timings and dry runs. Signing in, [Full Access] and errors are as for the rest of design mode. Test runs, profiled runs, dry runs, comparisons and AI-suggested test cases work on a throwaway copy of the file, offline, so the hosted data never changes; a file over 1 GB is not copied (400, code 960).

Source: `packages/server/src/design.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests`](#design-scripts-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests) | The file's script test cases, or one script's. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests) | Saves a test case (new, or replacing the one with its id): a script's inputs and what it should end with. |
| DELETE | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests/{id}`](#design-scripts-delete-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests-id) | Deletes a test case. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests/run`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests-run) | Runs test cases, all of them, one script's or the ones named, on a throwaway copy of the file, and says which passed. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests/record`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests-record) | Runs a script once with the given inputs, on a throwaway copy, and returns how it ended, to save as a test case's expectations. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests/suggest`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests-suggest) | Has the AI assistant write test cases for a script, runs each on a throwaway copy, and returns them with whether the script did what each expects; nothing is saved. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/history`](#design-scripts-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-history) | The script as each save in Tabularius left it, oldest first, as text, with who saved it and when. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/profile`](#design-scripts-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-profile) | Each step's time and run count from the script's runs on this server since it started, placed on the lines of the script's text. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/profile`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-profile) | Profile a run: runs the script once with a test case's inputs, offline on a throwaway copy, and returns that run's step timings and how it ended. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/dry-run`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-dry-run) | A dry run of a script that is not saved yet (a recorded macro): adds the steps to a throwaway copy as a new script, runs it once and returns what it would change. |
| GET, POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/refactor`](#design-scripts-get-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-refactor) | Where a script could be simpler or faster: dead branches, steps that cannot run, repeated steps, loops that find or commit on every record, and slow steps. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/compare`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-compare) | Proves a drafted version of a script does what the script does: runs both, offline on a throwaway copy, from each saved test case's inputs and from where buttons start it, then runs the saved test cases against the draft. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/dependencies`](#design-scripts-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-dependencies) | A script's dependency map: what its steps use, what starts it, and how it reaches outside the solution. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/dry-run`](#design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-dry-run) | A dry run: runs the script once, offline on a throwaway copy, and returns exactly which records it would create, change or delete, each field before and after. |

<a id="design-scripts-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests`

The file's script test cases, or one script's.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `script` | query | number | no | Only this script's cases, by id. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/script-tests?script=1
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "tests": [
    {
      "script": 1,
      "name": "finishes",
      "given": {},
      "expect": {
        "result": "ok",
        "error": 0
      },
      "id": "87293af5-04f2-42c5-bb8c-cc9e04980fa2"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests`

Saves a test case (new, or replacing the one with its id): a script's inputs and what it should end with.

The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/script-tests
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{

}
```

Response `200`:

```json
      "error": 0
    },
    "id": "87293af5-04f2-42c5-bb8c-cc9e04980fa2"
  }
}
```

A case that doesn't check out (no script of this file, no name, no expectation, too large) is 400, code 960, with the reason.

<a id="design-scripts-delete-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests-id"></a>

### `DELETE /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests/{id}`

Deletes a test case.

The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

```http
DELETE /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/script-tests/87293af5-04f2-42c5-bb8c-cc9e04980fa2

```

<a id="design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests-run"></a>

**Parameters:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/script-tests/run
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "script": 1
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "outcomes": [
    {
      "id": "87293af5-04f2-42c5-bb8c-cc9e04980fa2",
```

```http
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

```json

  "expect": {
    "result": "ok",
    "error": 0,

    "layout": "Items"
```

No script id: 400, code 960. Inputs that don't check out, or a run that can't be set up (a layout that isn't there), are 400, code 960, saying why.

<a id="design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-script-tests-suggest"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/script-tests/suggest`

Has the AI assistant write test cases for a script, runs each on a throwaway copy, and returns them with whether the script did what each expects; nothing is saved.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need"). The AI assistant must be running on the server (started with --ai), AI must not be turned off for the file, and the account needs AI access (the fmmcp extended privilege).

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `script` | body | number | yes | The script's id. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/script-tests/suggest
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "script": 1
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "name": "finishes with ok",
      "why": "The script should end with the result ok.",
      "given": {},
      "expect": {
        "result": "ok",
        "error": 0
      },
      "passed": true,
      "failures": [],
      "changes": {
        "create": 0,
        "update": 1,
        "delete": 0
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The model sees the script (secrets hidden) and the file's outline (layouts, tables and fields, script names), never its records. Up to 6 cases come back; one that does not check out is named in skipped. A case that failed lists failures [{what, expected, actual}] and, when the script ran, asRuns: the same case with what the script did in place of each missed expectation, to keep it as it runs now. changes counts the records the run would create, update and delete; more and emptied are added when it changed more than is listed or emptied a table. No such script: 404, code 104. The assistant off: 503, code 960. A model limit reached: 429. Another request already running for this file: 409. Closing the connection stops the model call.

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/1/history
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "versions": [
    {
      "seq": 2,

      "text": "Set Field [ Items::Status ; \"done\" ]\nExit Script [ Result: \"ok\" ]"
```

From the latest 5,000 design changes; saves made in FileMaker before the file came here are not in it, and a rename alone is no new version.

<a id="design-scripts-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-profile"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/profile`

Each step's time and run count from the script's runs on this server since it started, placed on the lines of the script's text.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The script's id. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/1/profile
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "profile": null,
  "recording": true
}
```

profile is null until the script has run; then it is shaped as in the POST below. recording says whether the server is timing scripts. Steps changed or moved since they were timed are left out and counted in changed. No such script: 404, code 104.

<a id="design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-profile"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/profile`

Profile a run: runs the script once with a test case's inputs, offline on a throwaway copy, and returns that run's step timings and how it ended.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The script's id. |
| `given` | body | object | no | The inputs, as a test case's given (parameter, layout, find, record, globals, ai). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/1/profile
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "given": {}
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "profile": {
    "since": "2026-10-13T00:09:08.564Z",
    "runs": 1,
    "totalMs": 1.23,
    "averageMs": 1.23,
    "maxMs": 1.23,
    "errors": 0,
    "lastRun": "2026-10-13T00:09:08.566Z",
    "steps": [
      {
        "index": 0,
        "line": "Set Field [ Items::Status ; \"done\" ]",
        "count": 1,
        "perRun": 1,
        "totalMs": 0.26,
        "averageMs": 0.26,
        "maxMs": 0.26,
        "errors": 0,
        "at": 1
      },
      {
        "index": 1,
        "line": "Exit Script [ Result: \"ok\" ]",
        "count": 1,
        "perRun": 1,
        "totalMs": 0.08,
        "averageMs": 0.08,
        "maxMs": 0.08,
        "errors": 0,
        "at": 2
      }
    ],
    "changed": 0
  },
  "ended": {
    "result": "ok",
    "error": 0,
    "foundCount": 3,
    "layout": "Items"
  }
}
```

at is the step's first line in the script text. Inputs that don't check out (a parameter over 20,000 characters, say) or a run that can't be set up: 400, code 960. No such script: 404, code 104. Methods other than GET and POST: 400, code 960.

<a id="design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-dry-run"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/dry-run`

A dry run of a script that is not saved yet (a recorded macro): adds the steps to a throwaway copy as a new script, runs it once and returns what it would change.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `text` | body | string | yes | The script's steps as text (up to 200,000 characters). |
| `given` | body | object | no | The inputs, as a test case's given. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/dry-run
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "text": "Set Field [ Items::Status ; \"done\" ]\nExit Script [ Result: \"ok\" ]",
  "given": {}
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "ended": {
    "result": "ok",
    "error": 0,
    "foundCount": 3,
    "layout": "Items"
  },
  "changes": {
    "records": [
      {
        "table": "Items",
        "recordId": 1,
        "kind": "update",
        "fields": [
          {
            "field": "Status",
            "before": "open",
            "after": "done"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "more": 0,
    "truncated": []
  }
}
```

The reply is shaped as for …/scripts/{id}/dry-run. Nothing is saved: the file itself never gets the script. A text that is missing, not a string, over the limit, or that does not parse: 400, code 960, saying why; inputs that do not check out: 400, code 960. Only POST.

<a id="design-scripts-get-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-refactor"></a>

### `GET, POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/refactor`

Where a script could be simpler or faster: dead branches, steps that cannot run, repeated steps, loops that find or commit on every record, and slow steps.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The script's id. |
| `text` | body | string | no | POST, required: the steps as the script editor has them open, as text. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/1/refactor
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "text": "Set Field [ Items::Status ; \"done\" ]\nExit Script [ Result: \"ok\" ]"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "hints": [
    {
      "kind": "repeated",
      "line": 1,
      "endLine": 3,
      "message": "Three Set Field steps in a row set the same field.",
      "fix": "Keep the last one."
    }
  ],
  "timed": false
}
```

Each hint is {kind, line, endLine, message, fix}, with the lines counted in the script's text from 1; kind is dead-branch, unreachable, repeated, same-as-script, record-loop, find-in-loop, commit-in-loop, slow-step or disabled. timed says whether the server's own step timings were used (slow-step hints): GET uses them for the saved script, POST only while the text is still the saved script. A POST without text is 400, code 960; text that does not parse is 400, code 960. No such script: 404, code 104. Other methods are 405.

<a id="design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-compare"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/compare`

Proves a drafted version of a script does what the script does: runs both, offline on a throwaway copy, from each saved test case's inputs and from where buttons start it, then runs the saved test cases against the draft.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The script's id. |
| `text` | body | string | yes | The drafted steps as text (up to 200,000 characters). |
| `base` | body | string | no | The steps the editor has open, when they are not saved yet: compared against instead of the saved script. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/1/compare
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "text": "Set Field [ Items::Status ; \"done\" ]\nExit Script [ Result: \"ok\" ]"
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "cases": [
    {
      "name": "finishes",
      "same": true,
      "differences": []
    },
    {
      "name": "a plain run",
      "same": true,
      "differences": []
    }
  ],
  "tests": [
    {
      "id": "87293af5-04f2-42c5-bb8c-cc9e04980fa2",
      "name": "finishes",
      "script": "Finish",
      "passed": true,
      "failures": [],
      "steps": 2,
      "ms": 4
    }
  ],
  "equal": true
}
```

Up to 10 cases are compared. A case is the same when the script and the draft end the same way (result, error, found count, layout, mode, variables, global fields, what they ask the client to do) and change the same records (fields the clock fills in are ignored); differences lists [{what, expected, actual}]. A case that cannot run, or changed more records than can be compared, proves nothing and counts as different. equal is true when every case is the same and every saved test case that passed before passes with the draft. Nothing on the real file changes. A missing or oversized text: 400, code 960. No such script: 404, code 104. Only POST.

<a id="design-scripts-get-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-dependencies"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/dependencies`

A script's dependency map: what its steps use, what starts it, and how it reaches outside the solution.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The script's id. |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/1/dependencies
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "script": "Finish",
  "uses": [
    {
      "kind": "field",
      "name": "Items::Status",
      "lines": [
        1
      ]
    }
  ],
  "startedBy": [
    {
      "how": "button",
      "name": "a button on layout \"Items\""
    }
  ],
  "outbound": []
}
```

uses lists fields, layouts, scripts, value lists and custom functions, each with the script lines that use it; byName: true marks a use found in text (GetField, ExecuteSQL, Evaluate, "by name" steps) that a rename would not reach. startedBy is {how: script | button | trigger, name}. outbound names how it reaches outside (mail, network, other apps, plug-in functions). No such script: 404, code 104. Only GET.

<a id="design-scripts-post-tabularius-design-v1-databases-database-scripts-id-dry-run"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/{database}/scripts/{id}/dry-run`

A dry run: runs the script once, offline on a throwaway copy, and returns exactly which records it would create, change or delete, each field before and after.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which design changes need").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | number | yes | The script's id. |
| `given` | body | object | no | The inputs, as a test case's given. |
| `text` | body | string | no | The script's steps as text, run in place of the saved ones on the copy (a draft not saved yet). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/design/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts/1/dry-run
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "given": {}
}
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "ended": {
    "result": "ok",
    "error": 0,
    "foundCount": 3,
    "layout": "Items"
  },
  "changes": {
    "records": [
      {
        "table": "Items",
        "recordId": 1,
        "kind": "update",
        "fields": [
          {
            "field": "Status",
            "before": "open",
            "after": "done"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "more": 0,
    "truncated": []
  }
}
```

Each record is listed once, from what it was to what it ends as; the first 200 are listed and more counts the rest. truncated lists tables Truncate Table emptied. incomplete: true means the run changed so much that only its earliest changes were read. message gives the line a script stopped on with an error. Values are cut at 2,000 characters. No such script: 404, code 104; bad inputs: 400, code 960. Only POST. With text (up to 200,000 characters) the copy's script is those steps first, to dry-run a draft that is not saved yet; text that is not a string is 400, code 960.

<a id="debug"></a>

## Script debugger and Data Viewer

The web client's script debugger and Data Viewer, at /tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}. It signs in with the Data API's session tokens and, as in FileMaker, needs [Full Access]. A debugging run belongs to the session that started it (other sessions get 404) and works, unless sent "scratch": false, on a throwaway copy of the file, offline (no network, mail or plug-ins), with the session's account and globals; starting and stepping answer when the script next pauses or finishes. A run nobody touches for 10 minutes, or whose session has ended, is halted. Errors come back as {"error": {"code", "message"}} with an HTTP status: a missing, expired or other file's token is 401 with code 952 (a session token sent for another file also ends that session), an account without [Full Access] is 403 with code 9, a file that is no longer open is 404 with code 802, a method a path does not answer is 405 with code 3 ("Command is unavailable"), a body that isn't JSON is 400 with code 960, and an error from the file itself (a bad change, a missing name) is 400 with its FileMaker error code.

Source: `packages/server/src/debug.ts`

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/scripts`](#debug-get-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-scripts) | The file's scripts and their steps as text lines, with the Scripts menu's order (folders and separators). |
| POST | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs`](#debug-post-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs) | Starts a script in the debugger and answers when it first pauses (at its first step, by default) or finishes. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs`](#debug-get-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs) | This session's debugging runs on this file, each where it waits or how it ended (the Data Viewer follows a paused one). |
| GET | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}`](#debug-get-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs-id) | One run: where it waits, with its variables, or how it ended. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}/{command}`](#debug-post-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs-id-command) | Step Into, Step Over, Step Out, Continue or Halt, and answers when the script next pauses or finishes. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}/next`](#debug-post-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs-id-next) | Set Next Step: moves the paused script to another step of the same script without running the ones between. |
| PUT | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}/breakpoints`](#debug-put-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs-id-breakpoints) | Replaces the run's breakpoints. |
| PUT | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}/options`](#debug-put-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs-id-options) | Turns Pause on error on or off for the run. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs/{id}/evaluate`](#debug-post-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs-id-evaluate) | The Data Viewer while paused: a formula's value where the script waits, with its local and global variables. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/evaluate`](#debug-post-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-evaluate) | The Data Viewer without a script: each formula on the record the web client shows, with that window's Get ( ) values and the session's $$variables. |
| GET | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/current`](#debug-get-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-current) | The Data Viewer's Current tab: the record's fields and the session's $$variables. |
| POST | [`/tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/recordings`](#debug-post-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-recordings) | Time travel: runs the script to the end on a throwaway copy, offline, recording each step (where it stood, its variables and found set, what it did to records) for stepping back and forth afterwards. |

<a id="debug-get-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-scripts"></a>

### `GET /tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/scripts`

The file's scripts and their steps as text lines, with the Scripts menu's order (folders and separators).

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which the script debugger needs").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |

**Example:**

```http
GET /tabularius/debug/v1/databases/Invoices/scripts
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "scripts": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "Finish",
      "steps": [
        {
          "line": "Set Field [ Items::Status ; \"done\" ]",
          "enabled": true
        },
        {
          "line": "Exit Script [ Result: \"ok\" ]",
          "enabled": true
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "order": []
}
```

order is left out when the file has no script order. Other methods are 405.

<a id="debug-post-tabularius-debug-v1-databases-database-runs"></a>

### `POST /tabularius/debug/v1/databases/{database}/runs`

Starts a script in the debugger and answers when it first pauses (at its first step, by default) or finishes.

**Permissions:** A session token for this file (Authorization: Bearer …, or X-FM-Data-Access-Token), from a Data API sign-in (which needs fmrest) or the web client's (fmapp or fmwebdirect), or a scoped API token (ohbt_…) for this file; a token scoped to surfaces must include fmrest, and one for a local-only account works only from the server itself. The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which the script debugger needs").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `script` | body | string | yes | The script's name. |
| `parameter` | body | string | no | The script parameter. |
| `layout` | body | string | no | The layout it starts on. |
| `foundSet` | body | array of number | no | Record ids of the starting found set. |
| `recordId` | body | number | no | The current record. |
| `breakpoints` | body | array of object | no | [{"script": name, "index": step position}]. |
| `pauseAtStart` | body | boolean | no | Pause at the first step (default true). |
| `pauseOnError` | body | boolean | no | Pause after a step that sets an error (default false). |
| `scratch` | body | boolean | no | false runs it on the hosted file, as the session's scripts otherwise run; default true (a throwaway copy, offline). |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/debug/v1/databases/Invoices/runs
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "script": "Finish",
  "layout": "Items",
  "pauseAtStart": true
}
```

Response `201`:

```json
{
  "id": "2adfd56e269493d4",
  "script": "Finish",
  "scratch": true,
  "breakpoints": [],
  "pauseOnError": false,
  "paused": {
    "script": "Finish",
    "index": 0,
    "steps": 2,
    "line": "Set Field [ Items::Status ; \"done\" ]",
    "stack": [
      {
        "script": "Finish",
        "index": 0
      }
    ],
    "lastError": 0,
    "layout": "Items",
    "foundCount": 3,
    "recordId": 1,
    "mode": "browse",
    "variables": {
      "locals": {},
      "globals": {}
    }
  }
}
```

Once it has finished the run has done (how it ended: result, error, halted, layout, found set …) instead of paused. A script that can't start (no such script) comes back as a run with error: {code: 104, message}. A file over 1 GB can't be copied for a scratch run: 400, code 960.

The account must have the [Full Access] privilege set; any other set gets 403, code 9 ("Account "…" doesn't have full access, which the script debugger needs").

**Parameters:**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `database` | path | string | yes | The hosted file's name (URL-encoded). |
| `id` | path | string | yes | The run's id. |
| `command` | path | string | yes | into, over, out, continue or halt. |

**Example:**

```http
POST /tabularius/debug/v1/databases/Invoices/runs/2adfd56e269493d4/continue
Authorization: Bearer 3f1d0c6e8a…
```

Response `200`:

```json
{
  "id": "2adfd56e269493d4",
  "script": "Finish",
  "scratch": true,
  "breakpoints": [],
  "pauseOnError": false,
  "done": {
    "result": "ok",
    "error": 0,
    "halted": false,
    "layout": "Items",
    "foundCount": 3,

      2,
      3
    ],

    "steps": 1,
    "actions": []
  }
}
```

On a run that has finished it just returns the run. While the script is running and not paused: 409, code 3 ("The script is running; wait for it to pause").

The Data Viewer without a script: each formula on the record the web client shows, with that window's Get ( ) values and the session's $$variables.
